The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 净化者自适应战斗装甲由圣言之书生产，最初的数据则是从 ComStar 窃取而来。它采用会变色的拟态装甲，堪称革命性设计。拟态装甲让净化者自适应装甲更难被锁定，静止时尤其如此。代价是它能携带的装甲量受到限制。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.872 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Yang's eager face makes it a little harder to strike a stern tone. "Chief, I'm going to give you this shipment. But," you add forcefully, "this time, I don't want to find half of your technicians in the MedBay. I mean it." Two days later, Yang shows up unannounced in your quarters. There's sweat on his brow, and his mechanical hand fiddles with an oil-soaked rag. "Boss… I swear we prepared them properly and with so much spice you'd think we were making an episode of DUNE!" You unconsciously try to rub the stress out of your forehead. "What's the bottom line?" Yang considers for a moment. "Well, most of the techs have come down with the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSHITS],S.H.I.T.S]] so I've scheduled shorter and more frequent shifts, and I've set up a couple rows of emergency latrines. Our efficiency should only be negatively impacted for a week, Boss. Tops."
column2: 杨那副跃跃欲试的表情，让你很难维持严厉语气。“老杨，这批货我交给你。但，”你加重语气，“这次我不想再看到一半技术员进医务室。听明白了吗？” 两天后，杨没打招呼就出现在你的舱室。他额头冒着汗，机械手摆弄着一块浸满机油的抹布。“老板……我发誓我们准备得很妥当，而且香料足到你会以为我们在拍《沙丘》！” 你下意识地揉了揉额头，试图缓解压力。“结果怎么样？” 杨想了想：“嗯，大多数技术员都染上了 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSHITS],S.H.I.T.S]]，所以我安排了更短、更频繁的轮班，还搭了几排应急厕所。效率最多只会受影响一周，老板。顶多一周。”

column1:
Yang's eager face makes it a little harder to strike a stern tone. "Chief, I'm going to give you this shipment. But," you add forcefully, "this time, I don't want to find half of your technicians in the MedBay. I want those tacos properly prepared and spiced."

Later in the week, word spreads of the dinner that Yang threw for his MechTechs, complete with a fresh batch of Engine Room Rustgut.

While not everyone got a chance to partake, the persistent aroma of freshly prepared tacos has somehow increased refit productivity, and your MechWarriors are happy with the results.
column2:
杨那副跃跃欲试的表情，让你很难维持严厉语气。“老杨，这批货我交给你。但，”你加重语气，“这次我不想再看到一半技术员进医务室。我要求那些塔可必须做熟、调好味。”

那周晚些时候，杨为机甲技师们举办晚餐的消息传开了，餐桌上还有刚做好的引擎室锈蚀肉。

虽然不是每个人都有机会参加，但新鲜塔可的浓郁香味不知怎么提高了改装生产率，而你的机甲战士对结果很满意。

column1: You address Front Man, "You were told last time that we are not interested. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] continues to remain in my employ and you can sort it out at the end of their contract." Front Man looks at you with displeasure, "This is a most unfortunate, Commander. We had hoped with time you would rethink our proposal. Know this, we will get our money from [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], with interest, and your company may end up as collateral damage as well." A smirk crosses your face, "Feels like deja vu." Front Man, smiles at you, "We shall see, Commander. We shall see." The image on the holocom winks out. Darius looks concerned, "Commander, he found us yet again. Is this the right course of action?" "Darius," you state calmly, "They threatened us before, and nothing has happened. They are all bluster. Think nothing more of it." Even then, you still wonder if you have heard the last from Front Man
column2: 你对中间人说：“上次已经告诉过你，我们没兴趣。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 仍然为我效力，等合同结束后你们再解决这件事。” 中间人不悦地看着你：“真是不幸，指挥官。我们原以为时间会让你重新考虑提案。记住，我们会连本带利从 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 身上拿回钱，你的公司也可能成为附带损失。” 你露出一丝冷笑：“似曾相识。” 中间人笑道：“我们走着瞧，指挥官。走着瞧。” 全息通讯画面熄灭。 达利乌斯忧心忡忡：“指挥官，他又找到我们了。这样处理真的对吗？” “达利乌斯，”你平静地说，“他们以前也威胁过我们，但什么都没发生。他们只是在虚张声势。别再想这件事了。” 即便如此，你仍不禁怀疑，自己是否已经听到了中间人的最后一句话。

column1: The Tomahawk II is designed around the use of a DSAM Endo 10-Composite internal structure, which gives the design its cavernous pod capacity of 56 tons. The 'Mech is powered by a 300-Rated Starfire Extra-Light Fusion Engine, giving it a maximum speed of 54 km/h. Protecting the engine and the Tomahawk II's other vitals is 19 tons of Advanced/3 standard armor, providing nearly maximum protection against enemy fire. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Tomahawk II 以 DSAM 内骨骼 10-复合结构为核心，因此拥有惊人的 56 吨挂载舱空间。它由 300 级 Starfire 超轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高速度为 54 公里/小时。19 吨高级/3 标准装甲保护着引擎和 Tomahawk II 的其他要害，几乎达到对敌方火力的最大防护。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.19 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: When the Argo arrives on the scene, it becomes clear that you've made the right decision. A handful of void-suited figures spin aimlessly away from a gaping hole in the hull in a last desperate bid for life. Your tech staff scoop up the survivors just before the transport explodes.\n\nLater in the week, however, Darius passes along a message from the planetary government. "Apparently, they credit us with the explosion. They've expressed their appreciation for helping to enforce the quarantine." He pauses, then adds, "I'll make sure MedBay keeps monitoring for an outbreak."
column2: 阿耳戈号抵达现场后，你确信自己做出了正确决定。几名身穿真空服的人影从舰体裂开的巨大破口旁无助地旋转漂浮，拼尽最后力气求生。运输船爆炸前，你的技术组及时救起了幸存者。\n\n然而那周晚些时候，达利乌斯转交了一条来自行星政府的消息：“他们似乎认为爆炸是我们造成的。他们感谢我们协助执行检疫。”他停顿片刻，又补充道：“我会让医务室继续监测，防止疫情爆发。”

column1: The Simian is a thirty-second century medium battle armor which was the brain child of Republic of the Sphere Paladin, Kara Rutherford. The design came about due in part to Paladin Rutherford's concern of the high cost of battle armor development. Her efforts to make a cost-effective design would give birth to the Simian, however, she would not live to see it enter production. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Simian 是一款 32 世纪中型战斗装甲，由球体共和国圣骑士卡拉·卢瑟福构想。高昂的战斗装甲研发成本促使她开始这项设计。她希望打造一种高性价比型号，最终催生了 Simian；然而在它投入生产前，她便已去世。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.87 可搭载任意单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Simian is a thirty-second century medium battle armor which was the brain child of Republic of the Sphere Paladin, Kara Rutherford. The design came about due in part to Paladin Rutherford's concern of the high cost of battle armor development. Her efforts to make a cost-effective design would give birth to the Simian, however, she would not live to see it enter production. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Simian 是一款 32 世纪中型战斗装甲，由球体共和国圣骑士卡拉·卢瑟福构想。高昂的战斗装甲研发成本促使她开始这项设计。她希望打造一种高性价比型号，最终催生了 Simian；然而在它投入生产前，她便已去世。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.868 可搭载任意单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Razorback is a design that excels at little, but is similarly deficient in few areas. Though the design is rather slow for a 'Mech of its size, it is rarely the slowest 'Mech on the field, either. Because of the 'Mech's general reliance on ballistic and missile weaponry, it does not have to worry about overheating under normal circumstances but is dependent on supply trains. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Razorback 没有特别突出的长处，但短板也不多。对于自身吨位而言，它的速度偏慢，却很少是战场上最慢的机甲。由于主要依赖弹道和导弹武器，正常情况下无需担心过热，但也因此依赖补给车队。 特性：窄体/低轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Grond is a massive 175-ton OmniMech built by Hallowed Iron Assembly for the Minnesota Tribe, visually resembling a larger Stone Rhino. Equipped with an Endo-Steel frame, a potent 350-rating XL engine, and Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, it expertly manages heat from its devastating energy weapons. Designed foremost as an offensive alpha-striker, the Grond unleashes overwhelming, high-impact volleys to shatter enemy defenses quickly. Its imposing presence and raw power embody the Tribe’s doctrine of relentless, decisive firepower, making it a terrifying force that dominates the battlefield with swift, crushing strikes.
column2: Grond 是一台重达 175 吨的巨型全能机甲，由圣铁工造为明尼苏达部落制造，外观像放大版的石犀。它采用内骨骼框架、强力的 350 级 XL 引擎和等离子电散热器，能够熟练处理毁灭性能量武器产生的热量。Grond 的首要定位是进攻型全弹齐射机甲，以压倒性的高冲击火力迅速击碎敌方防线。它的威严外形与原始力量体现了部落毫不留情、果断火力的信条，能以迅猛而沉重的打击主宰战场。

column1: The Yari is a Draconis Combine designed superheavy loosely based on the Orochi. The 145 ton 'Mech mounts a chassis-attached special type of experimental missile launcher which rotating tubes. Although this allows firing of far more missiles, the bulk and weight of the system means the rest of the design is left with little to no defensive capabilities and mobility. To add on top of this, there is also a reliability issue with the launchers which tend to cause both jamming and misfires.
column2: Yari 是龙辰联邦设计的超重型机甲，大致参考了 Orochi。它重 145 吨，底盘固定安装了一种带旋转炮管的实验型特殊导弹发射器。虽然这套系统能发射远多于普通发射器的导弹，但体积和重量过大，导致机甲几乎没有防御能力和机动性。此外，发射器还存在可靠性问题，容易卡弹和哑火。

column1: The Wulfen is a Clan Wolf light OmniMech which was first introduced shortly before the Clan's departure from its original Occupation Zone. The 'Mech utilizes its high speed and stealth technology to engage opponents in long-range combat. The Wulfen uses mix of advanced Clan and Inner Sphere technologies in its construction. The 'Mech is fitted with 300-rated XXL engine, Inner Sphere XL gyro, and endo steel which gives the 'Mech enough room for 10 tons of pod space. Among the 'Mech's other features is an ECM suite and six and a half tons of stealth armor.
column2: Wulfen 是狼氏族的轻型全能机甲，首次亮相于氏族离开原占领区前夕。它凭借高速和隐形技术与对手进行远程交战。Wulfen 的建造融合了先进氏族技术和内天体技术，配备 300 级 XXL 引擎、内天体 XL 陀螺仪和内骨骼，为 10 吨挂载舱空间提供余量。它还拥有 ECM 套件和 6.5 吨隐形装甲。

column1: After finishing the development of the Osteon, the Society moved into superheavy territory with the 150 ton Keratos. A 420 XL engine core provides the 'Mech's power, and a radical double heat sink kit is used as the cooling system. Still focused on ranged attack, mostly through ATM launchers, it shares many of the traits of the original Osteon. The Keratos is the first Society developed 'Mech that uses the new Superheavy CLPS, which operates at a slightly lower capacity than the standard version due to the difference in frame size of superheavies.
column2: 社团完成 Osteon 的研发后，又凭借 150 吨的 Keratos 进军超重型领域。420 XL 引擎核心为机甲提供动力，激进型双重散热器套件负责冷却。它仍然专注于远程攻击，主要依靠 ATM 发射器，并继承了许多 Osteon 的特征。Keratos 是社团研发的第一台采用新型超重型 CLPS 的机甲；由于超重型机架尺寸不同，其工作容量略低于标准版本。

column1: The Ophanim was created by the Word of Blake to become the keystone of their blessed military forces. Weighting in at 150t and utilizing a 425-rated core, the Ophanim brings Divine Wrath in its arms, and the Blessed Rains in the side torsos.  Those hoping that great weight given to the weaponry has cost it armor protection, will find that the Spirit of Blake has been blessed on this Sanctus Armor, helping to lift the load from those going to preach the Truth under fire.  Included as well, is a Blessed Gyro, and Seraphim EWAR Suite, both given blessings by the highest priests of the order, which has had some positive effects on combat performance. And to drive home the point that this is a model just for those who truly believe, it requires the pilot to have undergone significant cyberfication, to the point of almost embedding them into the cockpit.
column2: Ophanim 由圣言之书制造，旨在成为其神圣军力的核心。它重 150 吨，配备 425 级核心，双臂装有“神圣之怒”，两侧躯干装有“祝福之雨”。如果有人担心如此巨大的武器负载会牺牲装甲防护，那么布莱克之灵已经为它祝福了 Sanctus 装甲，减轻了那些在炮火下宣讲真理者的负担。它还配备受最高阶牧师祝福的祝福陀螺仪和 Seraphim 电子战套件，对战斗表现产生了积极影响。为了证明它只属于真正的信徒，驾驶员必须接受大规模控制论改造，几乎与驾驶舱融为一体。

column1: The Incubus II only has two torso-mounted ER Medium Pulse Lasers for offensive armament. A Laser AMS system was installed in the head to protect the pilot from missile attacks. The installation of more jump jets and the Partial Wing has reduced the available space for weaponry, but the Hell's Horses found an answer for that problem: They created several hand-held weapons systems that add additional firepower and provide commanders and pilots with some of the tactical flexibility of an OmniMech.
column2: Incubus II 的攻击武器只有安装在躯干上的两门 ER 中型脉冲激光。头部安装了激光 AMS 系统，用于保护驾驶员免受导弹攻击。更多跳跃喷口和部分机翼占用了武器空间，但地狱之马找到了应对办法：他们制造了多种手持武器系统，既能增加火力，也能让指挥官和驾驶员拥有全能机甲的战术灵活性。

column1: Produced jointly by Victory Conditions Industries and Eris Enterprises, the Jackalope represented a leap forward in anti-missile and recon technology. Designed to serve in recon and pursuit lances, this compact and swift BattleMech was used to full effect in combat, and additionally served as a training 'Mech and as an arena combat 'Mech. The 'Mech gets its name from a mythical animal which was said to have existed on Terra's North American continent.
column2: 胜利条件工业与厄里斯企业联合生产的 Jackalope，代表了反导与侦察技术的飞跃。它被设计用于侦察和追击长枪，在战斗中充分发挥了这台紧凑而迅捷的战斗机甲的性能，也被用作训练机甲和竞技场机甲。它的名字来自一种神话动物，据说曾生活在 Terra 的北美大陆。

column1: The Assassin II is the result of a Federated Suns specification calling for a 'quick strike harasser unit'. The Maltex Corporation proposed a major redesign of their older Assassin chassis, the resulting BattleMech exceeded all expectations and has started to see use as a counter to the stealth technology employed by the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Assassin II 源于联邦太阳提出的“快速突袭骚扰单位”需求。Maltex Corporation 对老款 Assassin 底盘进行了大幅重新设计，成品机甲超出所有预期，如今已开始用于对抗联邦制采用的隐形技术。

column1: The Balac is a formidable tankbuster for its tonnage boss, you certainly could do worse as far as support vehicles go.
column2: 以它的吨位而言，Balac 是一台极具威胁的坦克杀手，老板。说到支援载具，你很难找到比它更差的选择。

column1: Named after the mythological beings of power that almost rivals the Gods, the Jotunn is a Superheavy OmniMech designed by Clan Coyote. The 'Mech has seen widespread adoption amongst the Home Clans, often serving as the anchor of heavy assault Stars. A 375 XL engine serves as the powerplant, while a XL Omni helps increase the available podspace.
column2: Jotunn 以几乎能与诸神匹敌的神话巨人为名，是一台由郊狼氏族设计的超重型全能机甲。它在氏族母星广受采用，经常担任重型突击星群的核心。375 XL 引擎提供动力，XL 全能设备则进一步增加挂载舱空间。

column1: The lack of a Clan-made Superheavy QuadMech irked some of the more progressive scientists from the clans that had made it back to the Inner Sphere. So they decided to collaborate in secret on Project Colossus, meant to be the pinnacle of Clan design and ingenuity. The resulting 200 ton Quad OmniMech was eventually renamed to the Arachnid, and was more an ode to the decadence and delusion of grandeur that has started to seep into the Inner Sphere clans than fulfilling any practical role.
column2: 一些回到内天体的氏族进步派科学家，对氏族没有自行制造的超重型四足机甲十分恼火。于是他们秘密合作开展“巨像计划”，试图打造氏族设计与工程的巅峰。最终诞生的 200 吨四足全能机甲后来改名为 Arachnid，但它更像是内天体氏族逐渐沾染的奢靡与妄自尊大，而不是实用需求的产物。

column1: The only superheavy chassis Clan Widowmaker managed to design on their own, the Atrax is a 175 ton beast in the shape of a four-legged spider. Bringing all the strengths of a QuadMech and a Superheavy together, but at the cost of very limited mobility, the 'Mech was never favoured amongst the warriors of the Widowmaker touman, who only begrudgingly piloted the Superheavy. The strangest trait of the chassis are the four LRM-10 launchers that are constructed as a permanent part of the chassis, one in each knee.
column2: Atrax 是寡妇制造者氏族唯一独立设计的超重型底盘，重 175 吨，外形像一只巨大的四足蜘蛛。它结合了四足机甲与超重型机甲的所有优点，代价是机动性极差，因此从未受到寡妇制造者军团战士青睐，他们只是勉强驾驶这台超重型机甲。它最奇特的特征是四门永久固定在底盘上的 LRM-10 发射器，每个膝部各安装一门。

column1: As more and more Superheavy 'Mechs started appearing with the Inner Sphere and Clan armies, a rising demand for them was created within the periphery states as well. With their limited resources and more mundane needs, Earthwerks Limited saw an opportunity to create a cheap, simple design that still could take a beating. The choice was to create the 190 ton Thunderstone, trying to use the good reputation of the Thunderbolt as a launch platform it was designed with very similar looks. The high tonnage might at first seem to go against the cheap and simple concept, but it allows Earthwerks Limited to use less optimized components, which in turn allows the customers to do their own repair and maintenance at lower costs. The design comes with a 350 rated engine core, double heat sinks and an AMS by default.
column2: 随着内天体和氏族军队中越来越多的超重型机甲出现，边缘邦国也产生了需求。Earthwerks Limited 资源有限、需求朴素，于是看准机会，打造了价格低廉、结构简单却经得起打击的设计。他们选择制造 190 吨的 Thunderstone，并借用 Thunderbolt 的良好声誉，采用相似外形作为基础。高吨位乍看似乎违背低价简洁理念，但它允许 Earthwerks Limited 使用优化程度较低的部件，让客户以更低成本自行维修保养。该设计默认配备 350 级引擎核心、双重散热器和 AMS。

column1: The first Clantech OmniMech produced by Odin Manufacturing for the Ghost Bear Dominion, the Karhu (Finnish for "Bear") earned the reputation as a fast cavalry 'Mech. Built on an Endo Steel based chassis, powered by a 325-rated XL engine and clad in ten and half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Karhu featured respectable speed and armor for its size while providing thirty tons of available pod space for equipment. Twelve Double Heat Sinks coped with most of the waste heat of its varied configurations.
column2: Karhu（芬兰语意为“熊”）是奥丁制造为幽灵熊自治领生产的第一台氏族技术全能机甲，以快速骑兵机甲闻名。它采用内骨骼底盘、325 级 XL 引擎和 10.5 吨铁纤维装甲，在这一吨位下拥有可观的速度与防护，并提供 30 吨挂载舱空间。十二个双重散热器足以处理各种配置产生的大部分废热。

column1: The Balius is a quadrupedal, front-line OmniMech produced by Clan Hell's Horses. It is a totem 'Mech, resembling a horse, that is meant to improve morale as much as to be an effective combat unit. There is apparently no factory producing this design. Instead, it is hand-crafted by a crew of technicians specifically selected for the task by the Khan. This has led to few Balius' being produced, so the 'Mech is only in the hands of select Bloodnamed warriors. Truly a frontline Omni, the Balius makes use of weight-saving technologies in the form of an Endo Steel chassis, eleven tons of ferro-fibrous armor, and an XL engine. However, on a quad, this leaves little room for other components. It does allow for great speed, though, and the Balius maxes out at 97 km/h, quite fast for a 'Mech its size.
column2: Balius 是地狱之马氏族生产的四足前线全能机甲，外形像一匹马，是一种图腾机甲，既用于提升士气，也具备真正的战斗能力。据说没有工厂生产它，而是由可汗亲自挑选的技术员手工打造。因此 Balius 产量极少，只有少数拥有血名的战士能够使用。作为真正的前线全能机甲，它采用内骨骼、11 吨铁纤维装甲和 XL 引擎等减重技术，但四足底盘仍几乎没有空间容纳其他部件。不过这带来了极高速度，Balius 最高可达 97 公里/小时，对同体型机甲而言相当快。

column1: This design mask has no effect.
column2: 该设计面具没有任何效果。

column1: Juggernaut & Defender
column2: 主宰与防御者

column1: You mask the pain of what you are about to allow happen as you lock your gaze onto Front Man's image, "Let's get one thing straight. It is you, not I executing an innocent member of my crew. You are just trying to shake us down and extort more money from us. This company will not pander to blackmail." Front Man smiles at you evilly, "My dear Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, you are so quick to assume we are going to kill [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. That would be such a waste of a valuable resource. No, no, no... the Syndicate does not take kindly to being cheated and so we are going to put {TGT_MW.Callsign} to work for us to pay off your debt. I do hope you will be able to sleep at night with your decision knowing their life is going to change because you did not value them. Maybe next time, and I'm pretty sure there will be a next time, you'll decide differently. Oh, I also forgot to mention one other thing. I anticipated your decision and so I took the liberty of having one of my 'moles' leaving a small gift hidden in the [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]] currently in your MechBay." As the image on the holocom winks out, you hear the rumble of what can only be an explosion coming from the direction of the MechBay. As you and Darius rush to investigate, he sees your concerned look, "Commander, this will be very bad for morale."
column2: 你锁定中间人的影像，掩饰着即将允许发生之事带来的痛苦：“先把一件事说清楚。是你，不是我，在处决我手下无辜的成员。你只是在敲诈勒索，想从我们这里榨取更多钱。这家公司不会向勒索低头。” 中间人邪恶地笑了：“亲爱的指挥官 {COMMANDER.LastName}，你太快就认定我们要杀死 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。那会浪费一项宝贵资源。不，不，不……辛迪加不喜欢被骗，所以我们会让 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 为我们工作，用来偿还你的债务。希望你晚上还能睡得着，因为他们的人生会因你不珍惜他们而改变。也许下一次——我很确定还会有下一次——你会做出不同选择。对了，我差点忘了另一件事。我预料到了你的决定，所以让一名“内鬼”把一份小礼物藏进了目前位于你机甲库的 [[SCN_UNIT,{SCN_Unit.Name}]]。” 全息通讯画面熄灭时，你听到机甲库方向传来一声只能是爆炸的轰鸣。 你和达利乌斯赶去查看，他看到你忧虑的神情：“指挥官，这对士气会是毁灭性打击。”

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, you feel a momentary surge of hope: a handful of void-suited passengers spin aimlessly away from a gaping hole in the hull, awaiting rescue.\n\nThen an explosion abruptly brightens the starry expanse, enveloping the transport, the survivors, and the Argo. Dr. Murad's team spends the rest of the day repairing the damage. You spend the rest of the day repairing bruised morale.
column2: 阿耳戈号抵达遇险信标源头时，你短暂地燃起希望：几名身穿真空服的乘客从舰体裂开的巨大破口旁无助地旋转漂浮，等待救援。\n\n随后，一场爆炸突然照亮星空，将运输船、幸存者和阿耳戈号一并吞没。穆拉德博士的团队用余下的一整天修复损伤，而你则用同样的时间修复受创的士气。

column1: Using a series of proto-metal transformation cogs, this gear allows quick movement over the battlefield. Reserves 4 Slots
column2: 利用一系列原金属变形齿轮，这件装备能让使用者在战场上快速移动。占用 4 个槽位

column1: The 170 ton Stalker IV superheavy 'Mech, or the SuperStalker as commonly known amongst MechWarriors, is the creation of the best minds at the Republic Institute for Strategic Combat (RISC). It is an attempt to convert the otherwise somewhat fragile Stalker to a true superheavy juggernaut, combining the experimental Superheavy Ferro-Alloy armor with a reinforced structure and a heavy duty gyro. All together this creates an extremely durable basis for the rest of the 'Mech, although limited in free space and available weight capacity.
column2: 170 吨的 Stalker IV 超重型机甲，也就是机甲战士口中的 SuperStalker，是共和国战略战斗研究所（RISC）顶尖人才的成果。它试图把略显脆弱的 Stalker 改造成真正的超重型主宰，结合实验型超重型 Ferro-Alloy 装甲、强化结构和重型陀螺仪，形成极其坚固的基础，但可用空间和剩余载荷有限。

column1: The newest of the Word of Blake's Demon Series of battle armor is the Nephilim. Named for a group of half-angels from the bible who dwelt with mortals, the name may hint at the unit's intended close relationship with the Celestial series. Like the Celestial series, the Nephilim employs modular and/or detachable weapon mounts to give it a flexibility few other Demon series suits possess.
column2: Nephilim 是圣言之书恶魔系列最新的战斗装甲。它以圣经中与凡人共同生活的半天使族群命名，这个名字或许暗示了它与天体系列之间的紧密联系。和天体系列一样，Nephilim 采用模块化及可拆卸武器挂点，灵活性远超恶魔系列的其他装甲。

column1: The newest generation of Falcon OmniMechs represents a rift in design philosophy that mirrors the rift inside the Clan. The savage adherents of Malvina Hazen pilot more stylized ’Mechs like the Gyrfalcon and Shrike, whereas more moderate warriors prefer the toned-down aesthetics of newer machines like the Jade Phoenix, just as they prefer a toned down version of combat. The Jade Phoenix embodies what it means to be a true Jade Falcon, as did its namesake, the legendary Aidan Pryde.
column2: 新一代猎鹰全能机甲体现了设计理念的分裂，也映照出氏族内部的裂痕。马尔维娜·哈岑的狂热追随者驾驶 Gyrfalcon、Shrike 等风格张扬的机甲；更温和的战士则偏爱 Jade Phoenix 等审美收敛的新机型，也更倾向于克制的战斗方式。Jade Phoenix 体现了真正玉衡鹰战士的含义，正如它的名字来源、传奇人物艾丹·普莱德一样。

column1: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere.
column2: Quirinus 由 StarCorp Industries 在 Terra 生产，是一款 31 世纪末的中型战斗装甲，最初面向市场销售。它在共和国时代早期作为主力步兵装甲研发，最初卖给分裂的自由世界联盟。虽然外观不如同时代许多装甲华丽，但 Quirinus 以可靠著称，是一款优秀的战场单位。后来它进入雇佣兵部队和球体共和国部队手中。

column1: Cooperating with the Republic did Luthien Armor Works manage to create a upgraded version of the early Avatar OmniMech. Employing Advanced Technologies could it only be produced in limited numbers.
column2: 卢希恩装甲工坊与共和国合作，成功打造出早期阿凡达全能机甲的升级版。由于采用先进技术，该型号只能限量生产。

column1: Created by Blackwell Heavy Industries the 200 ton Shieldmaiden has one purpose and one purpose alone, defend against enemy forces. Equipped with both ranged defenses in form of various Anti-Missile Systems and electronic warfare systems it able to protect its own lance without much struggle against most attacks. The design has been sold all over both the inner sphere and the periphery, the only ones to not have been seen using it is the Clans.
column2: Blackwell Heavy Industries 制造的 200 吨 Shieldmaiden 只有一个目的：抵御敌军。它配备多种反导系统和电子战系统作为远程防御，能够轻松保护自己的长枪免受大多数攻击。该设计销往整个内天体和边缘地带，唯一尚未发现使用它的势力是氏族。

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang OmniMech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic armor, to blend into the night and hunt its victims.
column2: 阿斯旺以特兰土菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名。这台全能机甲采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀受害者。

column1: A prototype OmniMech built on the success of the Stormcrow line, fielded by Clan Wolf for trials before going into full production. Using a combination of a 330-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine and TSM, the 'Mech is able to achieve speeds up to 110 km/h. Perhaps the most startling innovation included in this design is the Clan Interface Armor, which allows a MechWarrior to interface with their 'Mech while being completely armored should they be forced to eject. This combination interface allows the Ryoken III pilot's a degree of control in combat, and removes the need to have a Gyro mounted in the 'Mech. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-armor interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor Armor.
column2: 这是一台基于 Stormcrow 系列成功经验打造的原型全能机甲，由狼氏族在全面生产前投入试验。330 级超轻型聚变引擎与 TSM 结合，让它的速度可达 110 公里/小时。最惊人的创新是氏族接口装甲：即使被迫弹射，机甲战士也能在完全装甲防护下与机甲连接。该接口让 Ryoken III 驾驶员在战斗中拥有更高控制力，也不再需要在机甲内安装陀螺仪。内天体势力曾以为这项技术在 Skinwalker 首次参战时已经失传。除了让驾驶员包裹在动力装甲接口中，机甲外壳还由 11.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲保护。

column1: Firefly Foundry built this alongside the Ranger as one of their first two designs, exclusively for Riley's Rangers. Three standard variants right out of the gate, each covering a different range bracket, and two more later on. The sixth variant, the ND-RRDS, is the odd one out, built in 3102 specifically to mark the partnership between the Rangers and Clan Sea Fox. That one also saw service with the Sea Foxes themselves, which tells you something about what the partnership was worth to both sides.
column2: 萤火虫铸造厂为 Riley 游骑兵制造了这台机甲，并将它与 Ranger 作为最初两种专属设计。它一开始就有三种标准变体，分别覆盖不同射程，后来又增加两种。第六种变体 ND-RRDS 是个例外，于 3102 年专门为纪念游骑兵与海狐氏族的合作而制造。它后来也在海狐部队服役，这足以说明双方都多么看重这段合作。

column1: The primary configuration of the Templar is intended to be able to engage an enemy effectively at any range. For effective long range hitting power, the Templar carries a powerful Gauss Rifle. If the Templar does close with an enemy, it can bring its highly accurate Large Pulse Laser, Medium Pulse Laser, and two ER Medium Lasers to bear on a target. For increased accuracy, the Gauss Rifle and all the lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer. The Templar Prime has a Streak SRM-4 launcher for seeking weak points in an enemy's armor.
column2: Templar 的主要配置旨在有效应对任何距离的敌人。远程火力依靠强力高斯步枪；如果敌人逼近，它还能用高精度大型脉冲激光、中型脉冲激光和两门 ER 中型激光还击。为提高精度，高斯步枪和全部激光都连接到高级瞄准计算机。Templar Prime 还配备 Streak SRM-4 发射器，用于寻找敌方装甲弱点。

column1: Designed on Mars during the Early Clanbuster program in an attempt to incorporate OmniMech Technology into a well understood Design. Named for Terran Mythology for a god of verastility and the ability to assume many form. Constantly being upgraded with the latest technologies first by Comstar, then Word of Blake and lastly by Republic Engineers.
column2: 这台机甲在早期“破族者”计划期间于火星设计，目标是把全能机甲技术融入一套成熟可靠的设计。它以特兰神话中一位能驾驭多种形态、象征多才多艺的神祇命名。它不断升级最新技术，先后由 ComStar、圣言之书，最后由共和国工程师进行改进。

column1: Developed as much to replace units lost as to prove the enduring industrial strength of the Draconis Combine, the Wight is a daring and innovative Mech design.
column2: Wight 的研发既是为了替代损失的部队，也是为了证明龙辰联邦持久的工业实力。这是一款大胆而创新的机甲设计。

column1: The Xiphos assault battle armor was developed by Irian Technologies specifically to create an infantry suit protected against artillery attacks, one of the most commonly-used tactics for defeating battle armor. Manufactured on Irian and Washburn for the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth (prior to the capture of Washburn by Clan Wolf) the Xiphos was manufactured in three common configurations and specifically incorporated a high-powered communications system to allow battlefield commanders to keep lines of communication open even in the face of hostile electronic countermeasures.
column2: Xiphos 强袭战斗装甲由 Irian Technologies 专门研发，用于打造能够抵御炮击的步兵装甲；炮击是消灭战斗装甲最常用的战术之一。它在 Irian 和 Washburn 为马里克-斯图尔特联邦生产（Wolf 氏族占领 Washburn 前），拥有三种常见配置，并特别配备高功率通信系统，让战场指挥官即使面对敌方电子反制也能保持通信畅通。

column1: The Mikasi is a fast, heavily armored OmniMech fielded by Clan Coyote. With a supercharged 300 XL engine, 20 tons of pod space, and Ferro-Lamellor armor, it's built for aggressive strike roles. Primarily used by Coyote front-line units, its variants offer strong firepower and mobility, with limited use outside the Clan.
column2: Mikasi 是郊狼氏族使用的高速重装全能机甲。它配备增压 300 XL 引擎、20 吨挂载舱空间和 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲，专为激进突击任务打造。它主要由郊狼前线部队使用，变体拥有强大火力和机动性，在氏族之外很少出现。

column1: The second of the Demon Series of battle armor to be spotted, the Tengu also appears to feature the most experimentation. Named after Japanese demons, the Tengu is unique for boasting both an enhanced ground speed and jump jets allowing it to leap sixty meters at a time in what some observers call "an overworked motive system arrangement."
column2: Tengu 是目前发现的第二种恶魔系列战斗装甲，也似乎是实验性最强的一种。它以日本传说中的妖怪命名，拥有增强型地面速度和跳跃喷口，一次可跳跃 60 米；有些观察者称这种配置为“过度强化的动力系统”。

column1: The Hel is noted for its large 40 ton Omni Pod Capacity. This improvement was achieved through reducing the size of the 'Mech's engine to a 260-Rated XL Fusion Engine, installing a Small Cockpit, and the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prime Configuration of the Loki is geared towards long-range combat. The 'Mech's arms are fitted with a pair of Gauss Rifles and ER Large Lasers. In closer ranges, MechWarriors have a right torso mounted 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher to add additional firepower where the Gauss Rifles become difficult to aim. The main guns are supplied with 3 tons of ammunition, while the Streak launcher is allotted a single ton. Two additional Double Heat Sinks are fitted to the Prime, to help it cope with the heat of the ER Larges.
column2: Hel 以巨大的 40 吨全能挂载舱容量闻名。这一提升通过缩小引擎、换用 260 级 XL 聚变引擎、安装小型驾驶舱并采用铁纤维装甲实现。Loki 的 Prime 配置专注于远程作战，双臂各装一门高斯步枪和 ER 大型激光。近距离时，右侧躯干的四管 Streak SRM 发射器可补充火力，弥补高斯步枪难以瞄准的问题。主炮配有 3 吨弹药，Streak 发射器配有 1 吨；Prime 还安装两个额外双重散热器，以应对 ER 大型激光产生的热量。

column1: The Italipas, or Chinook as it is known by Clan Coyote, was designed before but produced nearly 30 years after Clan Coyote’s touman was devastated in the Wars of Reaving. Built at the rebuilt Barcella Alpha facility using updated Nova Cat components, production was fast. This 70-ton heavy OmniMech sacrifices speed for firepower and protection, featuring a 280-rated XL engine with a supercharger boosting sprint speed from 64 to 86 kph. With 15.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor and an Endo Steel skeleton, it offers excellent defense and ample pod space despite its bulk.
column2: Italipas（郊狼氏族称其为 Chinook）早在郊狼氏族军团于掠夺战争中遭受重创前就已设计，但近 30 年后才投入生产。它在重建的 Barcella Alpha 工厂使用更新后的新星猫部件快速生产。这台 70 吨重型全能机甲牺牲速度换取火力和防护，配备 280 级 XL 引擎，并通过增压器将冲刺速度从 64 提升到 86 公里/小时。15.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲和内骨骼框架让它即使体型庞大，仍拥有出色防御和充足挂载舱空间。

column1: Quikscell came up with a clever idea in 3067, sell one cheap chassis and let customers buy different equipment kits for it. Six kits total covering pretty much every industrial job you can think of. Sold everywhere because it was affordable and flexible. Great Houses bought them, backwater planets bought them, mercenaries picked them up for the price. Quikscell stuff is never fancy but it gets the job done and parts are everywhere.
column2: Quikscell 在 3067 年想出了个聪明办法：先卖一台便宜底盘，再让客户购买不同设备套件。总共有六种套件，几乎覆盖所有能想到的工业工作。因为价格低、适应性强，它销往各处。大氏族买过，偏远星球买过，雇佣兵也按价格买来使用。Quikscell 的产品从不华丽，但总能完成任务，而且零件到处都能找到。

column1: The Taipan is a powerful medium OmniMech co-developed by Clans Star Adder and Cloud Cobra, named after the deadly Terran snake. Produced on Strana Mechty, Huntress, and a Deep Periphery world, it boasts 19 tons of pod space and Ferro-Lamellor armor. Though lacking in jump capability in most variants, it can deal and withstand heavy damage. Designed after the Society conflict, the Taipan is a versatile, hard-hitting OmniMech that demands caution whenever encountered on the battlefield.
column2: Taipan 是星蝰氏族与云蛇氏族联合研发的强力中型全能机甲，以 Terra 上的致命蛇类命名。它在 Strana Mechty、Huntress 和一颗深层边缘星球生产，拥有 19 吨挂载舱空间和 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲。虽然大多数变体没有跳跃能力，但它既能造成重创，也能承受重击。Taipan 在社团冲突后设计，是一款多用途、高火力的全能机甲，在战场上遭遇它时必须保持警惕。

column1: Dragon's Pride
column2: 龙之骄傲

column1: Superheavy Command Mech
column2: 超重型指挥机甲

column1: Ultralight IndustrialMech
column2: 超轻型工业机甲

column1: Slows mech down but makes it more stable
column2: 会降低机甲速度，但能提高稳定性

column1: The Winston is a solid Heavy tank Boss. Seventy tons of 'Mech would be better, but a Winston will do just fine.
column2: Winston 是一台很扎实的重型坦克，老板。要是有七十吨的机甲当然更好，但 Winston 已经很够用了。

column1: So you modified the files or had a bug, you should not have this mech. if it was a bug and you ended up with this mech please report it to Discord. If not think about this you are riding around in a semi sentient beings body.
column2: 你修改了文件，或者触发了某个漏洞，所以这台机甲本不该出现在你手里。如果这是漏洞导致的，请到 Discord 报告。否则，请想想自己正驾驶着一具半有知觉生命的躯体四处游荡。

column1: The Ghost Bears again had need of a cheap, versatile, second-line BattleMech. Thus the Bear Cub was put into production. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 幽灵熊再次需要一种廉价、灵活的二线战斗机甲，于是 Bear Cub 投入生产。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: You nod at Dr. Murad. "An excellent point, Doctor. The treatment certainly was an expensive endeavor. Reach out and see if they're interested in it."\n\nDarius and Dr. Murad immediately set to work arranging relief for the ailing shuttle.
column2: 你向穆拉德博士点头：“说得很好，博士。这项治疗确实代价高昂。去联系一下，看看他们是否有兴趣。”\n\n达利乌斯和穆拉德博士立即开始为那艘患病的穿梭机安排救援。

column1: Of the three designs that formed the Spectral LAM series built and deployed by the Word of Blake, the Yurei was the middleweight design Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 在 Blake 之言制造并部署的三种幽灵 LAM 设计中，Yurei 属于中型型号。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: You nod at Dr. Murad. "We're only one bad bug away from the same situation ourselves. Make arrangements for a transfer of supplies."\n\nSeveral days later, Sumire passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2: 你向穆拉德博士点头：“我们自己也只差一次糟糕的感染就会落到同样境地。安排转运物资。”\n\n几天后，Sumire 转达了来自星球地表的感谢，说你们妥善解决了这场危机。

column1: Vengeance Industries, attempting to get a foothold in the Market for OmniMechs, have redesigned the ancient Talos based on 'liberated' blueprints from Vandenberg MilTech. With a focus on easily maintainable parts, they have ensured that it can be repaired with spares from any Talos model.
column2: Vengeance Industries 想在全能机甲市场站稳脚跟，于是根据从 Vandenberg MilTech“弄来”的蓝图重新设计了古老的 Talos。它注重使用易于维护的零件，因此任何 Talos 型号的备件都能用于维修。

column1: The Sheng Long is a Quad type Heavy Class Battle Armor produced for both the Capellan Confederation and its close-allies in the Magistracy of Canopus. Designed with speed and firepower in mind, the Sheng Long employs its modular turret and stealth to out maneuver and assist in ambushing of enemy combat units.
column2: Sheng Long 是一种为卡佩兰联邦及其亲密盟友金星都督府生产的四足重型战斗装甲。它兼顾速度与火力，采用模块化炮塔和隐形技术，能够机动绕开敌方战斗单位并协助伏击。

column1: With a tone that brooks no discussion, you say, "We're not in the business of bailing out every wayward traveler. We need our medical supplies to get our MechWarriors back into the fight."\n\nDarius and Dr. Murad share a pointed look, but they keep any further thoughts to themselves and the daily briefing moves onto other topics.
column2: 你用不容置疑的语气说道：“我们不是来救助每一艘迷航船的。我们需要医疗物资，让机甲战士重返战场。”\n\n达利乌斯和穆拉德博士交换了一个意味深长的眼神，却没有再说什么，日常简报转向了其他话题。

column1: I've got other plans this evening, Darius, you say.\n\n"Excellent," says Darius. "I wasn't sure I could win if you were there tonight." He pauses, cocking an eyebrow to see if you're biting. When you just shake your head and smile, he says, "Damn!" and goes off to round up everybody else, leaving you to yourself for the evening.
column2: 你说道：“达利乌斯，我今晚另有安排。”\n\n达利乌斯说：“太好了。我还不确定你在场时自己能不能赢。”他停了一下，挑起眉毛，想看看你是否会上钩。你只是摇头微笑，他便喊道：“该死！”随后离开去召集其他人，把你独自留在今晚的清静里。

column1: The Mhacha is another genious design from the Morrigan program, named for a protective goddess was this Chassis designed to provide Long Range Firepower and AA Protection. Quirk: Morrigan C3i Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Mhacha 是 Morrigan 计划的又一款天才设计，以一位守护女神命名，旨在提供远程火力和防空能力。 特性：Morrigan C3i 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: The Crimson Langur is a remarkably fast 'Mech for its weight. In order to do this, it uses both an XL engine and an endo steel chassis to save weight. The design utilizes ten and a half tons of standard armor, the most the chassis can hold, though this weight only gives the Crimson Langur fifteen tons of pod space for modular equipment.
column2: Crimson Langur 以自身吨位而言快得惊人。它采用 XL 引擎和内骨骼框架减重，并装有 10.5 吨标准装甲，这是底盘能承载的最大装甲量；即便如此，这些装甲仍只为模块化设备留下 15 吨挂载舱空间。

column1: The Bee is a recent addition to the Inner Sphere OmniMechs. Designed as a mix between a scout and a flanker, it can fullfil both roles decently thanks to its large engine and relatively large available pod space. The design has been successful enough to be used by most of the Inner Sphere factions, making it an increasingly more common sight.
column2: Bee 是最近加入内天体全能机甲行列的新型号。它兼顾侦察与侧翼突袭，凭借大引擎和相对充足的挂载舱空间，能够胜任这两种任务。该设计十分成功，几乎被所有内天体势力采用，因此越来越常见。

column1: Sumire catches your attention on the bridge. "Commander, I've picked up a distress call from a nearby civilian transport. It's not exactly our job to assist in matters like this, but we may be the nearest ship available."\n\nShe studies the display. "On the other hand, it looks like the ship's engines are in a critical state. They could explode before we get there."
column2: Sumire 在舰桥上叫住你：“指挥官，我收到附近一艘民用运输船发来的遇险信号。按理说这不归我们管，但我们可能是附近唯一能赶到的船。”\n\n她看着显示屏说道：“不过，那艘船的引擎已经处于危急状态。我们赶到之前，它们可能就会爆炸。”

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.898 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Phalanx 是 Irian Technologies 在自由世界联盟制造的战斗装甲设计，是 FWLM 对 Kanazuchi、Gnome 等更大、更重火力战斗装甲的回应。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.898 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "We're only one bad bug away from the same situation ourselves. Make arrangements for a transfer of supplies."

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision and the large contingent of lifelong spacers in the crew express their support.

Sumire also passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2:
你向穆拉德博士点头：“我们自己也只差一次糟糕的感染就会落到同样境地。安排转运物资。”

接下来几天，你的决定在舰内逐渐传开。船员中有许多在太空生活了一辈子的人，也有曾亲身熬过边缘瘟疫的机甲战士，大家的支持汇成一股热潮。

Sumire 还转达了来自星球地表的感谢，说你们妥善解决了这场危机。

column1: The 'jmy-wt', or Imiut, is a heavier OmniMech upgrade of the Anubis Scout Mech, sporting Clan grade Endo-Steel with a unique Stealth Suite integrated with its Ferro Fibrous Armor does it sport extreme agility and firepower to comparable Designs Quirk: OmniStealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: ‘jmy-wt’即 Imiut，是 Anubis 侦察机甲的重型全能升级版，采用氏族级内骨骼，并将独特的隐形套件整合进铁纤维装甲，使它兼具极高的机动性和火力。 特性：全能隐形 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: You and Yang join Sumire in watching a new production of an old comedy of manners set during a lull in the Third Succession War. Halfway through the story, you're unsurprised to find that none of the other crew who peeked in have stayed. Sumire and Yang egg each other on so much in their vocal response to the show that if the story hadn't been familiar to all of you, you never would have been able to follow it.
column2: 你和 Yang 陪 Sumire 观看一部新拍的老派喜剧，故事发生在第三次继承战争的短暂间歇期。剧情过半时，其他曾探头进来的人果然一个都没留下。Sumire 和 Yang 对节目你一言我一语地吐槽，声音此起彼伏；要不是你们都熟悉这个故事，恐怕根本看不懂剧情。

column1: The Gauntlet is a medium-class OmniMech that was manufactured for the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces. It was designed as a swift cavalry unit capable of keeping up with lighter 'Mechs while also being able to bring the flexibility and firepower of a medium 'Mech. Quirk: Adv. M.A.S.C. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Gauntlet 是一款为莱拉联邦武装部队制造的中型全能机甲。它被设计成快速骑兵单位，既能跟上轻型机甲，又能发挥中型机甲的灵活性和火力。 特性：高级 M.A.S.C. 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: With the success of the Mad Cat Mk II design Clan Diamond Shark developed the Mad Cat III as a medium 'Mech to accompany the heavy Mad Cat and assault Mad Cat II. Intended for sale to both Inner Sphere and Clan customers, it has been shunned by the Clans save for the Nova Cats and Exiled Wolves as '...an outrage against everything Nicholas Kerensky stood for and taught us.' However, it has proven popular with the Successor States.
column2: Mad Cat II 取得成功后，钻石鲨氏族又开发了中型 Mad Cat III，用来搭配重型 Mad Cat 和强袭型 Mad Cat II。它原本面向内天体与氏族客户销售，却遭到氏族普遍排斥，只有新星猫和流亡狼例外；他们称其为“对 Nicholas Kerensky 所坚持和教导的一切的侮辱”。不过，继承国反而很喜欢这款机甲。

column1: Taking inspiration from the R20 series of mechs, this Urbanmech was designed from the ground up to be a cheap and nasty ambusher aimed at the mercenary market. The combination of stealth armour and rockets allow it to savage targets and withdraw. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 Urbanmech 参考 R20 系列，从头打造为面向雇佣兵市场的廉价阴险伏击者。隐形装甲与火箭让它能够重创目标后迅速撤离。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1:
With a tone that brooks no discussion, you say, "We're not in the business of bailing out every wayward traveler. We need medical supplies to get MechWarriors back into the fight."

Darius and Dr. Murad share a pointed look, but they keep any further thoughts to themselves and the daily briefing moves onto other topics.

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision, leading to heated arguments on both sides.
column2:
你用不容置疑的语气说道：“我们不是慈善机构，但可以分出一些医疗物资。去联系一下，看看他们愿不愿意付钱。”

达利乌斯意味深长地看了穆拉德博士一眼，但两人没有再说什么，日常简报转向了其他话题。

接下来的几天，你的决定在舰内传开，船员们因此争论不休。

column1: The Goshawk II is a Medium BattleMech built by Clan Snow Raven in the mid-3080s. Based on the heavier Vapor Eagle (also known as the Goshawk), it is produced on the Inner Sphere world of Dante. The Goshawk II was designed as a second-line BattleMech for use exclusively by the Ravens. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Goshawk II 是雪鸦氏族在 3080 年代中期制造的中型战斗机甲。它以更重的 Vapor Eagle（也称 Goshawk）为基础，在内天体的 Dante 星生产，专供雪鸦作为二线战斗机甲使用。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：1.07 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: This Urbie is primitive repurposing at its best, but it works. A salvaged wreck of an Urbie, this has been dragged off of the battlefield and crudely repaired with parts taken from industrial mechs and ancient weapons. Little more than a mobile turret, it looks and sounds scarier than it is. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.77 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台 Urbie 是废物再利用的典范，虽然粗糙，却确实能用。它原本是一台在战场上被拖走的 UrbanMech 残骸，后来用工业机甲零件和古老武器拼凑修复。它基本就是一座移动炮塔，看起来、听起来都比实际更吓人。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：0.77 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Pack Hunter II is a light BattleMech produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal during the Jihad. The 'Mech would first appear in combat in 3077 after a considerable amount of delays in its development. The design was originally seen as the OmniMech successor to the original Pack Hunter, however the Blakist attack against Arc-Royal and other priorities caused the delays. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: Pack Hunter II 是流亡狼氏族在圣战期间于 Arc-Royal 生产的轻型战斗机甲。由于研发一再延期，它直到 3077 年才首次参战。最初它被视为原版 Pack Hunter 的全能继任者，但 Blakist 袭击 Arc-Royal 以及其他优先事项导致开发延误。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "An excellent point, Doctor. The treatment certainly was an expensive endeavor. Reach out and see if they're interested in it."

Darius and Dr. Murad immediately set to work arranging relief for the ailing shuttle.

Over the next several days, however, word of your decision trickles through the ship and not everyone agrees. Those who previously suffered through the Periphery Pox are especially loathe to extort payment from other victims of the unforgiving disease.
column2:
你向穆拉德博士点头：“说得很好，博士。这项治疗确实代价高昂。去联系一下，看看他们是否有兴趣。”

达利乌斯和穆拉德博士立即开始为那艘患病的穿梭机安排救援。

然而接下来几天，你的决定在舰内逐渐传开，并非所有人都赞同。那些曾遭受边缘瘟疫折磨的人尤其不愿向同病相怜的受害者索取报酬。

column1: The Angerona Scout Suit was developed by StarCorp Industries on Terra. The suit was designed for the needs of the newly formed Republic of the Sphere's Armed Forces, with the lessons learned from Stone's Coalition during the Jihad in mind. It utilizes its stealth capacities and quick movement to scout ahead of friendly forces without being detected. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Angerona 侦察战斗装甲由 Terra 上的 StarCorp Industries 开发。它面向新成立的球体共和国武装部队，吸取了圣战期间 Stone 联盟的经验，利用隐形能力和高速机动，在不被发现的情况下侦察友军前方。 特性：灵活 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1:
In the daily briefing, Sumire brings up an open hail from a nearby ship. "They say their crew has contracted a virulent case of the Periphery Pox, but the local government is preventing them from landing to receive medical care."

Darius shrugs. "We could sell them some of our medical supplies. It would limit us in the MedBay for a bit, but given their situation, I expect they'd pay up."

Dr. Murad bristles at this suggestion. "Spacers should stick together, Commander. Besides, the local authorities might appreciate our generosity."
column2:
日常简报时，Sumire 提起附近一艘船发来的公开呼叫：“他们说船员感染了凶猛的边缘瘟疫，但当地政府不允许他们降落接受治疗。”

达利乌斯耸耸肩：“我们可以卖给他们一些医疗物资。这样会让医疗舱暂时紧张，但看他们的处境，我想他们会愿意付钱。”

穆拉德博士对这个提议很不满：“太空人应该互相照应，指挥官。而且，当地当局或许会感谢我们的慷慨。”

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

You lean forward. "Speak for yourself. I'm here to win." 

Dr. Murad, who only attends to socialize, soon vanishes, and Yang is out early, but the bout between you, Sumire and Darius goes late into the night. Eventually Darius, master negotiator, talks both you and Sumire into giving up the fight and heading to bed.

"He would have won everything eventually anyhow," Sumire says, as the two of you leave Darius smugly counting the largest pile of chips.
column2:
达利乌斯一边洗牌一边说道：“这只是朋友间的游戏。”

你身体前倾：“别替我说。我是来赢的。”

只想来社交的穆拉德博士很快离场，Yang 也早早出局，但你、Sumire 和达利乌斯之间的牌局一直持续到深夜。最后，谈判高手达利乌斯说服你和 Sumire 放弃争斗，回去睡觉。

Sumire 离开时说：“反正他迟早会把一切都赢走。”达利乌斯得意洋洋地数着最大的一堆筹码。

column1: The Subjugator is a 120 ton Clan BattleMech with one focus, long range devastating strikes with its Improved Railgun and other weapons. It is slightly less heavily armored than most Superheavy units, but instead relies on other means such as mobility or stealth to be effective in battle. Besides the fixed Improved Railgun in the right torso, the other very interesting thing with the design is the Encased Cybernetic Cockpit; this cockpit encases the piloting MechWarriors in extra thick armor and utilizes a window less design to lower the amount of weakspots.
column2: Subjugator 是一台 120 吨的氏族战斗机甲，核心任务是利用改进型轨道炮和其他武器实施远程毁灭性打击。它的装甲略逊于大多数超重型单位，却依靠机动性和隐形等手段保持战斗力。除了右侧躯干固定安装的改进型轨道炮，最引人注目的是封装式义体驾驶舱：它用额外厚重的装甲包裹驾驶员，并采用无窗设计，减少薄弱点。

column1:
You nod at Dr. Murad. "We've been here before, and we have a stash of antivirals in the MedBay to show for it. We have an obligation to pass on our good fortune. Make arrangements for a transfer of supplies."

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision. Between the large contingent of lifelong spacers in the crew and those MechWarriors who survived their own personal brush with the Periphery Pox, there's a wave of support.

Sumire also passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2:
你向穆拉德博士点头：“我们经历过这种事，医疗舱里还留着一批抗病毒药，正是证据。我们有义务分享这份好运。安排转运物资。”

接下来几天，你的决定在舰内逐渐传开。船员中有许多在太空生活了一辈子的人，也有曾亲身熬过边缘瘟疫的机甲战士，大家纷纷表示支持。

Sumire 还转达了来自星球地表的感谢，说你们妥善解决了这场危机。

column1: The Avalanche is a thirty-second century medium OmniMech, first deployed by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat. After decades of development, the Avalanche would still have a number of design flaws which would give it a bad reputation among warriors of Clan Nova Cat. The 'Mech would soon be deployed shortly before House Kurita's invasion of the Republic of the Sphere, where it would serve among House Kurita's elite forces. After the destruction of Clan Nova Cat, as a result of its revolt against Coordinator Yori Kurita, the dead Clan's allotment of Avalanches would be sold off to other Inner Sphere powers.
column2: Avalanche 是一款 32 世纪的中型全能机甲，最初由龙辰联邦和新星猫氏族部署。经过数十年开发，它仍存在不少设计缺陷，在新星猫战士中名声不佳。它很快在 Kurita 家族入侵球体共和国前投入部署，成为 Kurita 家族精锐部队的一员。新星猫氏族因反抗 Yori Kurita 协调官而毁灭后，死去氏族留下的 Avalanche 配额被卖给了其他内天体势力。

column1: So look Commander, this thing is a gigantic beast but it's really an IndustrialMech SLDF Prototype made for working on DropShips that is over 300 years old. I am not sure how _these_ fraggers have kept the thing running for 300 years, but I'm pretty sure one of the arms is like 6 legs of various UrbanMechs welded together. The ''armor'' is just the chest pieces of what has to be dozens of other mechs welded onto this freakshow. I have no idea why but the locals have been using it to build barns. For cows. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32
column2: 听着，指挥官，这东西看起来像头巨兽，但它其实是三百多年前制造的 SLDF 工业机甲原型，用来维修登陆舰。我真不知道这些混蛋是怎么让它运转三百年的，但我敢肯定，它的一条手臂是把六条 UrbanMech 的腿焊在一起做成的。至于“装甲”，不过是几十台其他机甲的胸甲焊到这头怪物身上。我也说不清为什么，当地人一直用它来盖牛棚。给牛盖的。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.32

column1: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Djinn 是目前已知的第一种恶魔系列战斗装甲，由 Blake 之言为其 Manei Domini 制造。它经过精心打造，专门用来震慑敌人。纤细的外形表明它是为 Manei Domini 步兵特别设计的：他们的义体强化弥补了那些“脆弱”的元素战士及其内天体对手操控战斗装甲所需的肌肉体格。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：0.886 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The closest thing the Demon Series of battle armor has to a standard, front-line model, the Asura is a medium-weight design. Compared to the Clan Elemental the Asura is not as well armored, although its 280kg of advanced armor can withstand a hit from a Clan ER Medium Laser. The Asura does not have any enhancements to a standard trooper's ground speed but carries jump jets to leap ninety meters at a time, matching the Elemental in terms of speed, and its weaponry has a longer reach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Asura 是恶魔系列战斗装甲中最接近标准前线型号的一款，属于中型设计。与氏族元素战士相比，它的装甲较薄，但 280 千克先进装甲足以抵挡一发氏族 ER 中型激光。Asura 没有增强普通步兵的地面速度，却配备跳跃喷口，每次可跳跃 90 米，速度与元素战士相当，武器射程则更远。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：0.872 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Se'irim is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series, named for the satyr-like beings from Hebrew folklore. Used only in significant numbers by the elite Manei Domini, the Se'irim is the stealthy complement to the Asura. Where the latter serves as a main battlesuit the former specializes in ambush tactics. It carries 330kg of stealth armor, enough to stop a Medium Pulse Laser, which it uses along with its incredible ground speed get into cover and wait for the enemy's approach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Se'irim 是 Blake 之言恶魔系列中的一种战斗装甲，以希伯来传说中类似萨堤尔的生物命名。它只由精锐 Manei Domini 大量使用，是 Asura 的隐形搭档。Asura 负责正面作战，Se'irim 则专精伏击。它携带 330 千克隐形装甲，足以挡下一发中型脉冲激光，并凭借惊人的地面速度进入掩体，等待敌人靠近。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：0.872 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: You fill out all the information required in the form, check it twice, then hit the submit link. You hand the datapad back to Darius, "There, all done. Now we wait and see what..." A DING alert sounds on the datapad. Darius opens it up, "Well, Commander, looks like you are going back to school to learn how to fly VTOLs!" You smile, "I guess I better start packing. And Darius, don't bankrupt the company while I'm away!" Darius looks shocked, placing a hand on his chest, "Commander! I'm more than capable of running things while you are away." You shake your head as you head to your quarters to pack hoping that this course only takes less than 6 months to complete.
column2: 你填写完表格中的所有信息，检查两遍后点击提交。你把数据板交还给达利乌斯：“好了，全部完成。现在等着看结果……” 数据板发出叮的一声提示。达利乌斯打开消息：“指挥官，看来你要回学校学习如何驾驶垂直起降机了！” 你笑道：“看来我得开始收拾行李了。还有，达利乌斯，我不在的时候可别把公司弄破产！” 达利乌斯震惊地捂住胸口：“指挥官！我完全有能力在你离开时管理好一切。” 你摇摇头，回舱室收拾行李，只希望这门课程不会超过六个月。

column1: Despite being designed by the Star League before the Exodus, the Dragon Fire was not seen in the Inner Sphere until the 3050s. However, an updated version of the original Star League design was developed as proposed to Clan leadership during the Golden Century but was never adopted in favor of Omnimechs designs. Not willing to give up on the design, several members of the Society continued redesigning the Dragon Fire in secret. By the Wars of Reaving, the Dragon Fire IIC Omnimech is vastly more advanced than it's Inner Sphere cousin. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 尽管 Dragon Fire 在大撤离前就由星盟设计完成，但直到 3050 年代才出现在内天体。黄金世纪期间，氏族领袖曾有人提议采用原版星盟设计的升级型号，却最终偏爱全能机甲而放弃。社会氏族的几名成员不愿就此罢手，继续秘密重设计 Dragon Fire。到掠夺战争时，Dragon Fire IIC 全能机甲已经远胜它的内天体近亲。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Rogue Bear 首次确认部署于 3073 年，是幽灵熊氏族生产的战斗装甲。它最初被误认为 Golem，是一种重型战斗装甲，最早部署在驻军单位中，尤其是后来并入幽灵熊军团的 KungsArmé 部队。Rogue Bear 每次可跳跃 60 米，装甲厚度几乎足以挡住高斯步枪。它主要采用标准部件，没有一次性武器。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.935 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Slower than the Medium Tank, but possessing heavier armor and fire power, the Heavy Tank is a fearsome combatant. Packing a potent array of heavy weapons, the Heavy Tank is a serious threat to any Tank or Mech that encounters it. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Glazed (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 280 30 Left 235 30 Right 235 30 Rear 190 30 Turret 220 30 Total 1160 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 重型坦克速度低于中型坦克，但装甲和火力更强，是令人生畏的战斗单位。它装备一整套强力重武器，任何遇到它的坦克或机甲都必须认真对待。 生物群系限制：无。 移动力：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：镀层（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 前 后 前方 280 30 左侧 235 30 右侧 235 30 后方 190 30 炮塔 220 30 总计 1160 150 特性：主战坦克

column1: A fast unit, the Light VTOL is not designed for protracted combat. Intended as a scout or vanguard unit, the Light VTOL is constantly on the move, probing ahead of the rest of the troops. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 125 18 Left 100 18 Right 100 18 Rear 85 18 Turret 15 18 Total 425 90 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Wingmounted
column2: 轻型垂直起降机速度很快，却不适合持久作战。它被设计成侦察或先导单位，始终保持移动，探查部队前方。 生物群系限制：无法部署于月面生物群系。 移动力：11/17 格 / 330/510 米。 装甲：铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 前 后 前方 125 18 左侧 100 18 右侧 100 18 后方 85 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 425 90 特性：精准武器 - 翼装

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

You lean forward. "Speak for yourself. I'm here to win."

Dr. Murad, who only attends to socialize, soon vanishes, and Yang is out early, but the bout between you, Sumire and Darius goes late into the night. 

Eventually Sumire shakes her head. "I have to get some sleep," and withdraws, stalking away from the game table. 

Shortly after that, Darius says, "You win, Commander. This time. That was an excellent game. I'll see you in about three hours for our daily meeting." He too departs, leaving you alone with a big pile of chips representing some of your staff's earnings. They'll get them back again when you pay them next, anyhow.
column2:
达利乌斯一边洗牌一边说道：“这只是朋友间的游戏。”

你身体前倾：“别替我说。我是来赢的。”

只想来社交的穆拉德博士很快离场，Yang 也早早出局，但你、Sumire 和达利乌斯之间的牌局一直持续到深夜。

过了一会儿，Sumire 摇头说道：“我得去睡了。”她离开牌桌，头也不回地走远。

不久后，达利乌斯说：“你赢了，指挥官。这次赢得漂亮。三小时后日常会议见。”他也离开了，只留下你和一大堆代表员工收入的筹码。反正等你下次发薪，他们就会拿回去。

column1: The Snake is a 'Mech that was built under the aegis of an Elemental hunter. With the power of hindsight though the Snake is clearly designed to hunt Inner Sphere Battle Armor suits. The 'Mech is built using a Vox 225 XL Engine to move at a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Snake also has a jumping capability of one hundred and fifty meters making it capable of outmaneuvering any battle armor suit and also keeping it on par with most medium 'Mechs. The Snake is also armored with seven tons of armor and uses double heat sinks to cool the 'Mech's excess heat. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Snake 是在元素战士猎杀者计划支持下建造的机甲。现在回头看，很明显它就是为了猎杀内天体战斗装甲而设计的。它采用 Vox 225 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 86.4 公里/小时；跳跃能力达到 150 米，足以机动压制任何战斗装甲，也能跟上大多数中型机甲。Snake 还配备 7 吨装甲和双重散热器，用于处理机甲多余热量。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1:
This is just a friendly game, Darius intones as he shuffles the deck of cards.

You lean forward. "Speak for yourself. I'm here to win." 

Dr. Murad, who only attends to socialize, soon vanishes, and Yang is out early, but the bout between you, Sumire and Darius goes late into the night.

Sumire doesn't miss a beat tonight, either. "The biggest advantage you have in your negotiations," she says to Darius as she collects another pot, "is that your victims don't know you like I do."

"You've just been lucky," Darius says, frowning.

"Keep telling yourself that and play another hand," Sumire challenges. But Darius does a bit of math and withdraws. You wisely follow him out, leaving Sumire snickering in front of her winnings.
column2:
达利乌斯一边洗牌一边说道：“这只是朋友间的游戏。”

你身体前倾：“别替我说。我是来赢的。”

只想来社交的穆拉德博士很快离场，Yang 也早早出局，但你、Sumire 和达利乌斯之间的牌局一直持续到深夜。

今晚 Sumire 也毫不手软。她收下一底牌，对达利乌斯说：“你谈判时最大的优势，就是你的受害者不像我这么了解你。”

达利乌斯皱眉：“你只是走运。”

Sumire 挑衅道：“继续这么安慰自己，再来一局。”达利乌斯算了算筹码，选择退出。你也明智地跟着离桌，只留下 Sumire 对着自己的战利品窃笑。

column1: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Ironhold 强袭战斗装甲由玉衡鹰氏族在圣战期间开发。它的源头可追溯到 3069 年反人员高斯步枪的研发。该武器成功后，玉衡鹰第三利爪集群的元素战士三元组支持启动了代号“铁砧”的项目，开发新型战斗装甲。Ironhold 比典型氏族强袭装甲更灵活，能够使用跳跃喷口，获得更好的战术位置。 特性：装甲化 部署费用倍率：0.96 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Darius cracks open a new deck of cards. "Because not everybody here follows the rules." You blink innocently, consider the mental state of your staff, and decide how you want the game to resolve. Despite close scrutiny, it isn't hard for you to throw the game to Yang. Your Chief MechTech enjoys himself hugely, crowing over each hand he wins and refusing to believe that you've been manipulating the game. The final hand is played shortly before midnight and Yang goes off to his quarters whistling. "That was fun," you say. "Look how happy he is. You two don't really mind, do you?" Darius gives you a hard smile. "Of course not, Commander. I was playing from the company's petty cash fund." "Hey!" Sumire says, outraged. "Next time let me in on that!"
column2: 达利乌斯拆开一副新牌：“因为这里不是每个人都会遵守规则。”你无辜地眨眨眼，考虑了一下船员们的心理状态，决定让这场牌局如何收场。 尽管有人严密盯着，你还是轻松地把牌局让给了 Yang。你的首席机修师玩得非常开心，每赢一手就欢呼，还完全没意识到你一直在操纵牌局。最后一手在午夜前结束，Yang 吹着口哨回了舱室。 你说道：“真有意思。看他多开心。你们两个不会介意吧？” 达利乌斯露出僵硬的笑容：“当然不会，指挥官。我用的是公司的零用金。” Sumire 气恼地喊道：“什么！下次也让我参加！”

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, a bleak picture greets you. The transport drifts aimlessly, no longer even venting oxygen from a gaping hole in its hull.\n\nWhile you're too late to help, your tech staff does manage to salvage some scrap for the Mech Bay from the floating tomb. Grim work, but necessary for survival in the Periphery.
column2: 阿耳戈号抵达遇险信标源头时，眼前是一片惨淡景象。运输船在太空中漫无目的地漂浮，舰体破了个大洞，却连氧气都已经不再泄漏。\n\n虽然你们赶到时已经来不及救援，但技术组还是从这座漂浮的坟墓里抢救出一些废料，带回机甲库。工作令人沉重，却是边缘生存所必需的。

column1: {COMMANDER.FirstName}! It's poker night! Darius is prowling outside your quarters as you return after dinner.\n\nPoker night. Darius first insisted because he said it would help 'keep his skills sharp.' He doesn't always win, so perhaps he's right. It's usually the senior staff he ropes into playing, although occasionally some other 'lucky' crew member or guest is invited to the table. But you're the boss. He can't make you play.
column2: “{COMMANDER.FirstName}！今晚打扑克！”你晚饭后回到舱室，达利乌斯正守在门外。\n\n扑克之夜。达利乌斯最初坚持举办牌局，说这样能“保持手感”。他也不是每次都赢，所以或许确实有道理。通常是高级船员被他拉来参局，偶尔也会邀请某个“幸运”的船员或访客入座。不过你是老板，他没法强迫你参加。

column1: The Suski is a medium OmniMech developed by Clan Coyote for the renewed invasion of the Inner Sphere. Drawing on Society Septicemia data and Stormcrow components, it features 13 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor for enhanced durability. While sacrificing some pod space, most variants include a Supercharger to match the speed of its sibling, the Mikasi. The Suski’s blend of old tech and modern updates makes it a resilient and fast striker, ideal for rapid assaults and extended frontline engagements.
column2: Suski 是郊狼氏族为重新入侵内天体而开发的中型全能机甲。它吸收社会氏族败血症计划的数据，并采用 Stormcrow 的部件，配备 13 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲以提高耐久性。大多数变体牺牲部分挂载舱，安装增压器以追上姊妹机 Mikasi 的速度。Suski 将老技术与现代升级结合，成为坚韧而迅捷的突击机甲，适合快速突袭和长时间前线作战。

column1: Inspired by the success of the Clan Hell's Horses' Black Hawk design, Clan Diamond Shark developed what is in essence a simplified, non-Omni version of the older Mist Lynx OmniMech. Primarily for sale to Inner Sphere customers, the Hell's Horses marketing ploy of adopting a familiar designation the 'Mech was dubbed the Koshi, a decision that did not sit well with many of the more conservative members of the Clan. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 受地狱之马氏族 Black Hawk 设计成功的启发，钻石鲨氏族开发了 Koshi。它本质上是旧式 Mist Lynx 全能机甲的简化非全能版本，主要面向内天体客户销售。为了营销，氏族借用了地狱之马熟悉的命名方式，但这一决定让许多保守派成员颇为不满。 特性：窄体/低轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: You nod at Darius. "You're right. If anyone can appreciate their plight, it's the Argo. We'll share the treatment." Darius and Dr. Murad immediately set to work arranging relief for the ailing shuttle. Over the next several days, word of your decision trickles through the ship. Those who previously suffered through the Periphery Pox are very supportive of helping other victims of the unforgiving disease. Several days later, Sumire passes along a message of thanks from the planet's surface for resolving the situation favorably.
column2: 你向达利乌斯点头：“你说得对。要是有人能体会他们的处境，那就是阿耳戈号。我们把治疗方案分享出去。” 达利乌斯和穆拉德博士立即开始为那艘患病的穿梭机安排救援。 接下来几天，你的决定逐渐在舰内传开。那些曾经熬过边缘瘟疫的人，都非常支持帮助其他受这种无情疾病折磨的受害者。 几天后，Sumire 转达了来自星球地表的感谢，说你们妥善解决了这场危机。

column1: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Quirinus 由 Terra 上的 StarCorp Industries 生产，是一款 31 世纪末面向市场销售的中型战斗装甲。它在共和国时代早期作为主力步兵装甲研发，最初卖给分裂的自由世界联盟。虽然外观不如同时代许多装甲华丽，但 Quirinus 以可靠著称，是优秀的战场单位。后来它进入雇佣兵部队和球体共和国部队手中。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.89 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Darius cracks open a new deck of cards. "Because not everybody here follows the rules." You blink innocently, consider the mental state of your staff, and decide how you want the game to resolve. You have to play carefully to give Sumire the game, because neither she nor Darius trusts you at the table. But Yang inadvertently helps, over and over, and Sumire is happy enough to accept each hand she wins. After the game concludes and only you and Darius are left finishing your drinks, you say, "Have you noticed how the MechWarriors pick up on Sumire's moods? How can you mind losing when the whole ship is happier this way?" Darius gives you a hard smile. "I don't mind, Commander. I was playing from the company's petty cash fund."
column2: 达利乌斯拆开一副新牌：“因为这里不是每个人都会遵守规则。”你无辜地眨眨眼，考虑了一下船员们的心理状态，决定让这场牌局如何收场。 你得小心演牌，才能把胜局让给 Sumire，因为她和达利乌斯都不信任你坐在牌桌上。不过 Yang 一次又一次无意中帮了忙，Sumire 也乐得收下每一手胜局。牌局结束后，只剩你和达利乌斯喝着酒，你说：“你有没有注意到，机甲战士总能察觉 Sumire 的情绪？整艘船因此更开心，你又何必介意输掉一局？” 达利乌斯露出僵硬的笑容：“我不介意，指挥官。我用的是公司的零用金。”

column1: The Xiphos assault battle armor was developed by Irian Technologies specifically to create an infantry suit protected against artillery attacks, one of the most commonly-used tactics for defeating battle armor. Manufactured on Irian and Washburn for the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth (prior to the capture of Washburn by Clan Wolf) the Xiphos was manufactured in three common configurations and specifically incorporated a high-powered communications system to allow battlefield commanders to keep lines of communication open even in the face of hostile electronic countermeasures. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Xiphos 强袭战斗装甲由 Irian Technologies 专门研发，用于打造能够抵御炮击的步兵装甲；炮击是消灭战斗装甲最常用的战术之一。它在 Irian 和 Washburn 为马里克-斯图尔特联邦生产（狼氏族占领 Washburn 前），拥有三种常见配置，并特别配备高功率通信系统，让战场指挥官即使面对敌方电子反制也能保持通信畅通。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.9 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，不可群袭。
