column1: It looks like an oversized Wolverine kitted out with whatever random things they had been unable to sell. It has mediocre weapons, mediocre gear and mediocre mobility. I am not really sure why this was created in the first place. Maybe it was just straight to sale 'Mech to clear overstock of components?
column2: 看起来像一台超大号 Wolverine，装满了他们卖不出去的各种杂物。它的武器、设备和机动性都很平庸。我真不明白当初为什么要造这东西。也许只是为了清理积压部件，直接拿来销售的机甲？

column1: The Arctic Wolf II is a Clan Wolf-in-Exile Medium OmniMech that was developed during the Jihad, and finally deployed in 3085. The design is based on the OmniMech variant of the original Arctic Wolf. The original OmniMech version had a number of problems, including technical glitches and a lack of speed.
column2: Arctic Wolf II 是一台流亡狼氏族的中型全能机甲，圣战期间开始研发，最终于 3085 年部署。该设计基于原版 Arctic Wolf 的全能机甲型号。原始全能机甲版本存在许多问题，包括技术故障和速度不足。

column1: Why waste space on rarely used rocket fuel, when you can have more booms? Try Quicsell exclusive Deadfire Thunderbolt ammo today! Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 很少使用的火箭燃料占空间干什么？不如换成更多爆炸！立即试用 Quicsell 独家 Deadfire Thunderbolt 弹药！受到暴击后，弹药箱内剩余的所有弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可降低风险。

column1:
Darius approaches you on the bridge, "Commander, I have been informed that all repairs to our drives have been completed and we are now back to 100% efficiency."

You nod, "Thank you, Darius."

Sumire, standing over by the Kerby-Fucheatah Console, grabs your attention, "Commander, do you want to activate the KF Console?
column2:
Darius 走到舰桥上，向你说道：“指挥官，我获悉我们推进器的所有维修工作均已完成，现在已恢复 100% 效率。”

你点头：“谢谢你，Darius。”

站在 Kerby-Fucheatah 控制台旁的 Sumire 引起了你的注意：“指挥官，您要激活 KF 控制台吗？”

column1: This Dark Age variant is used by the Duchy of Andurien. It carries a Mine Dispenser instead of the Modular Weapon Mount of the original. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这个黑暗时代型号由安杜林公爵领使用。它用布雷投放器替代了原版的模块化武器挂点。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载任何单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The Hauberk mounts improved stealth armor to keep from being targeted effectively. The size of the battlesuit precludes its ability to be transported on OmniMechs or perform anti-'Mech operations, though it does mount a battle claw. Its slow speed generally limits its use to defensive operations, though it has been known to travel by armored personnel carrier. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 豪伯克装配了改进型隐形装甲，以避免被有效锁定。战斗服体型过大，无法由全能机甲运输，也无法执行反机甲作战，但配备了一只战斗爪。其速度缓慢，通常仅限于防御行动，不过也有过由装甲运兵车搭载行进的记录。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.896 只能通过内部舱运输，可近战，无法进行蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Hacked models could carry either a light machine gun or a "David" light gauss rifle in their right-arm modular weapon mounts, and still carried the AP weapon mount and battle claw in the left. Though effective in extending a sensor network and providing targeting data, the tradeoff in weapons, armor, and mobility was too great, and the Principality shelved the project. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Hacked 型号可在右臂模块化武器挂点中搭载轻机枪或“David”轻型高斯步枪，同时左臂仍保留反人员武器挂点和战斗爪。虽然这种配置在扩展传感器网络、提供目标数据方面十分有效，但武器、装甲与机动性的牺牲过大，亲王国最终搁置了该项目。 特性：设计精良 部署费用倍率：0.908 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可进行蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Gullfaxi Omnimonitor was the second project by the design team that made the Gulltoppr for Clan Wolf in Exile and the Lyran Commonwealth. Packing a significant percentage of its predecessors firepower into a smaller and significantly cheaper package. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 600 105 Left 500 105 Right 500 105 Rear 400 105 Turret 400 105 Total 2400 525 Quirk: Tacticon TC7000 Omni Vehicle
column2: Gullfaxi 全能监视车是那支曾为流亡之狼氏族和莱拉联邦打造 Gulltoppr 的设计团队开发的第二个项目。它将前代机型相当一部分的火力压缩进更小、也便宜得多的车体中。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲：装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 600 105 左侧 500 105 右侧 500 105 后部 400 105 炮塔 400 105 总计 2400 525 特性：Tacticon TC7000 全能载具

column1: The Crow Scout VTOL is a military-grade, scout combat vehicle that is based upon the civilian Soar. Yan Manufacturing designed the Crow to replace the many scout BattleMechs the Draconis Combine lost during the Combine-Ghost Bear War. The Yan team kept many of the strengths of the search-and-rescue vehicle the Crow is descended from, though they improved it using military-grade technologies. Yan initially had trouble selling the Crow to the DCMS. Finally, Yan agreed to give the unit to them as long as the Combine supplied the electronics. In exchange, Yan is free to sell the unit to mercenary units. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 10 Left 30 10 Right 30 10 Rear 30 10 Total 140 50 Quirk: Improved Sensors
column2: Crow 侦察垂直起降机是一种军用级侦察战斗载具，源自民用 Soar。燕氏制造公司设计 Crow，用来替代龙蛇合众国在合众国—幽灵熊战争中损失的大量侦察战斗机甲。燕氏团队保留了 Crow 所源自的搜救载具的许多优点，同时以军用级技术加以改进。燕氏起初很难将 Crow 卖给龙蛇合众国军。最后，燕氏同意将该单位交给他们，前提是由合众国提供电子设备。作为交换，燕氏可以自由向雇佣兵部队出售该单位。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月面生物群系部署。 移动：13/20 格 / 390/600 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 40 10 左侧 30 10 右侧 30 10 后部 30 10 总计 140 50 特性：改进型传感器

column1: The Hellspawn was designed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support BattleMech. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a Guardian ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of armor that is barely adequate when compared to other medium 'Mechs. To enhance the 'Mech's mobility it has six jump jets. The 8E is a variant aimed at increasing the 'Mech's long range effectiveness. Two of the Medium Pulse Lasers have been traded for lighter ER Medium Lasers and an Artemis IV system has been added to the LRMs. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Hellspawn 的设计源于联邦合众国对现代化、高机动火力支援战斗机甲的需求。Hellspawn 采用内骨钢底盘和一台 270 型 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 97.2 公里/小时。为提供防护，Hellspawn 配备 Guardian ECM 套件，并装有六吨半装甲；与其他中型机甲相比，这样的防护仅算勉强够用。为了增强机甲机动性，它装有六具跳跃喷射器。8E 型号旨在提高机甲的远程作战效能：其中两门中型脉冲激光器替换为更轻的 ER 中型激光器，LRM 则加装了 Artemis IV 系统。 特性：改进型冷却套 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: The Fire and Forget Missile system came into being when producing the latest LRM systems became problematic due to limited supply sources. To simplify reloading mechanisms, these new systems reduced the number of tubes and enlarged each missile to compensate for the loss in volume with higher payloads and stronger guidance systems. \n\n Uses FAF Ammo.
column2: 发射后不管导弹系统诞生于最新 LRM 系统因供应来源有限而难以生产之时。为简化重新装填机构，这些新系统减少了发射管数量，并增大每枚导弹，以更高的载荷和更强的制导系统弥补容量损失。 \n\n 使用 FAF 弹药。

column1: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 km/h and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 联邦合众国寻找不依赖弹药的战斗机甲时，Dart 应运而生。这台机甲以极高速底盘搭载全能量武器配置，最高速度可达 151 公里/小时，并装有三吨半装甲。虽然武装较轻，Dart 却是出色的侦察机甲；它的能量武器使其能够独立行动，在游击部队中同样表现出色。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：0.96

column1: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 km/h and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 联邦合众国寻找不依赖弹药的战斗机甲时，Dart 应运而生。这台机甲以极高速底盘搭载全能量武器配置，最高速度可达 151 公里/小时，并装有三吨半装甲。虽然武装较轻，Dart 却是出色的侦察机甲；它的能量武器使其能够独立行动，在游击部队中同样表现出色。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Cuirass main armament is the Rotary AC/5 carried in the left arm. Identical to the weapon used on the Legionnaire and Blade BattleMechs, this weapon can easily knock smaller opponents right off their feet. Three tons of ammunition keeps the Cuirass fighting for a long time. Unlike the Legionnaire the Cuirass can close with an enemy unit and finish it off with either its ER Medium Laser or (if it needs to cool down) the two ton Sword mounted in the right arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 胸甲的主武器是安装在左臂上的旋转 AC/5。这种武器与军团士兵和刀锋战斗机甲使用的武器相同，足以轻易将较小的对手轰倒在地。三吨弹药让胸甲能够长时间持续战斗。与军团士兵不同，胸甲可以逼近敌方单位，再用 ER 中型激光器将其消灭；如果需要冷却，也可以使用右臂安装的两吨重剑。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下

column1: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 245 25 Left 140 25 Right 140 25 Rear 90 25 Turret 155 25 Total 770 125 Quirk: Battle Computer B2000
column2: 大名指挥部是龙蛇合众国使用的一种重型战区指挥单位。第一台大名于 2796 年继承战争初期由栗田仁次郎投入使用；他曾在肯塔雷斯大屠杀期间使用这辆载具。统治协调官亲自主持处决时，大名指挥部的乘员将数据传送给星球上的星联代表，后者再把数据发送至整个内圈。栗田发现叛变后，整支乘员组都遭到处决。由于该单位的通信系统技术变成了失落科技，大名的生产在 3027 至 3063 年间停滞。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 245 25 左侧 140 25 右侧 140 25 后部 90 25 炮塔 155 25 总计 770 125 特性：B2000 战斗计算机

column1: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 15/23 hexes / 450/690 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 5 Left 10 5 Right 10 5 Rear 10 5 Total 80 25 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile
column2: 雪貂轻型侦察垂直起降机于 2901 年首次装备达维昂家族部队，后来又被马利克家族、施泰纳家族以及部分外围势力采用。这种载具是先进的侦察单位，能够监视敌军动向并呼叫炮击。凭借自身速度，一架雪貂便可巡逻长达二十公里的战线，迅速往返于各个区域之间。该载具装甲薄弱，几乎任何种类的机甲武器命中都能摧毁雪貂。然而，雪貂的任务是避免战斗；它的敏捷性使其能够在增援抵达前始终处于敌方武器的有效射程之外。除侦察和炮兵校射外，雪貂的货舱容量也使其适合运输与救援行动。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月面生物群系部署。 移动：15/23 格 / 450/690 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 40 5 左侧 10 5 右侧 10 5 后部 10 5 总计 80 25 特性：窄体/低轮廓

column1: The Donar Assault Helicopter is a versatile VTOL that is useful in a variety of roles, similar in concept to the Inner Sphere's Warrior. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 15 Left 100 15 Right 100 15 Rear 85 15 Total 475 75 Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting
column2: 多纳尔突击直升机是一种用途多样的垂直起降机，能够胜任多种角色，其设计理念类似于内圈的勇士。直升机由飞行员和副驾驶兼炮手操作，两人前后串列就座；即使其中一人失去行动能力，另一人的位置也保留了有限的冗余能力。三吨 A2F 复合铁素体装甲能够抵御轻武器射击，旋翼即使遭受 40 毫米口径武器命中也仍可运转。坚固的装甲外壳还让多纳尔在低空坠毁事故中拥有很高的生存率。和大多数垂直起降机一样，多纳尔速度很快，最高可达 151 公里/小时。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月面生物群系部署。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲：铁素体纤维（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 175 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后部 85 15 总计 475 75 特性：防空瞄准

column1: The Dragoon was conceived as a heavier, more versatile battlesuit for Wolf’s Dragoons’ Seventh Kommando. The Dragoon offers more protection and flexibility than common infiltration suits. This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 龙骑兵是为狼之龙骑兵第七突击队构思的一种更重、更通用的战斗服。与常见的渗透战斗服相比，龙骑兵提供了更强的防护和灵活性。这套战斗服最初是为战斗工程师设计的，旨在高风险渗透行动中提供一定程度的战场防护，同时融入轻型战斗服所具备的行动便利性。 特性：直觉式控制 部署费用倍率：0.89 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可进行蜂拥攻击。

column1: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon 'Mech, but lack of interest forced the design to be shelved two years later. In 2990, Kallon Industries rediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The 'Mech is designed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy armor. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the 'Mech is hard pressed to defend itself. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 大黄蜂于 2760 年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但由于缺乏兴趣，该设计在两年后被搁置。2990 年，卡隆工业重新发现蓝图并恢复生产。升级版 HNT-171 于 3051 年开始生产。生产线在 3069 年被卡佩兰人摧毁。这台机甲围绕快速穿行城市环境、同时具备相对厚重装甲的理念设计。总体而言，由于武器组合繁杂且速度相对缓慢，大黄蜂只有在城市内部才能发挥一定效能。一旦身处城市之外，这台机甲就很难自我防御。 特性：窄体/低轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: You look Front Man directly in the face, "How much?" Front Man looks intrigued, "How much for what, my dear Commander?" "How much to buy [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s marker? No strings, no further obligations," you state succinctly. Front Man steeples his fingers, "You would be willing to bail [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] out of the hole they dug themselves into? Interesting... very well, if you wish to end this here an now it will cost you ¢1,349,663. My assistant has just sent you the account details." You turn to Darius, "Make the transfer." Darius types in some information into the console, then nods, "Transfer complete Commander." Front Man looks away for a minute before turning back to you, "The deal is done, Commander. You are an interesting one, I do so hope we meet again!" As you kill the connection, you state, "The feeling is NOT mutual." The holocom connection closes. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes over and grabs your hand, "Thank you! I... I do not know what to say!" You smile at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Just do your job and be the best MechWarrior you can. Oh, and no more gambling!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] cannot keep the smile of {SCN_MW.OBJ} face, "Absolutely Commander!"
column2: 你直视着 Front Man 的脸：“多少钱？” Front Man 饶有兴致地问道：“亲爱的指挥官，要买什么的多少钱？” “买断 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的标记要多少钱？不附带任何条件，也没有后续义务。”你简洁地说道。 Front Man 十指交叉：“你愿意把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 从他们自己挖出的坑里捞出来？有意思……好吧，如果你想在此时此地了结此事，需要支付 ¢1,349,663。我的助手刚刚把账户详情发给你。” 你转向大流士：“进行转账。” 大流士在控制台输入一些信息，然后点头说道：“转账完成，指挥官。” Front Man 移开视线片刻，随后转回来看着你：“交易完成了，指挥官。你真是个有趣的人，希望我们还能再见！” 切断连接时，你说道：“这种感觉并不相互。”全息通信连接关闭。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 冲过来抓住你的手：“谢谢你！我……我都不知道该说什么！” 你对着 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 微笑：“做好你的工作，成为最优秀的机甲战士。还有，别再赌博了！” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 脸上的笑容无法褪去，{SCN_MW.OBJ}说道：“遵命，指挥官！”

column1: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: Chameleon的设计旨在帮助新晋机甲战士掌握机动和热量管理技巧，最高速度达97.2公里/小时，跳跃距离为180米。 这台机甲几乎全是能量武器配置，却只有十个标准散热器负责冷却。散热器数量如此匮乏，迫使机甲战士时刻关注机甲的热量水平。 在某些情况下，Chameleon也被迫投入战斗，最著名的例子就是Dragoon内战期间。3052年，Defiance Industries决定将生产线改为制造Nightsky，Chameleon的生产一度中止；但J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated买下设计版权后，生产很快恢复。J.B. BattleMechs还推出了Chameleon的两个实战型变体。 Chameleon是一台训练机甲，通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各式各样的对手。它属于中型机甲，却不总是看起来像中型机甲。它可以加装额外装甲板来改变外观，并配备能够伪造自身特征的特殊电子设备；这些能力让它看起来、扫描起来都像别的东西，这正是它得名Chameleon的原因。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.04

column1: Introduced in 2740 by the Terran Hegemony, the Myomer Accelerator Signal Circuitry (MASC) is a piece of equipment that allows a BattleMech to move at twice its walking speed. However, actuators were not built for this kind of stress, and prolonged usage of MASC systems can damage the leg actuators of a BattleMech. Although this is unlikely to immobilize the BattleMech, the danger of destroyed actuators is enough for cautious warriors to limit their use in battle. Activatable: DEALS DAMAGE AND CRIT TO LEGS ON FAILURE
column2: 2740年，Terran Hegemony首次引入肌肉纤维加速信号电路（MASC）。这是一种能让战斗机甲以两倍步行速度移动的设备。然而，执行器并非为承受这种压力而设计，长时间使用MASC系统可能损坏战斗机甲的腿部执行器。虽然这不太可能让战斗机甲彻底失去行动能力，但执行器损毁的风险足以让谨慎的战士限制其在战斗中的使用。 可激活：失效时会对腿部造成伤害并触发暴击

column1: Marrying the Streak System from Clantech Launchers to a MML selector system allowed RISC Engineers to create this fine Marvel of Technology. Unusually for them, it's unlikely to explode. Uses Clan Streak SRM/LRM Ammo. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
column2: 将氏族科技发射器中的Streak系统与MML选择器系统结合后，RISC工程师创造出了这项卓越的科技奇迹。它一反常态，几乎不会爆炸。 使用氏族Streak SRM/LRM弹药。 战斗中左键点击命中率，在LRM和SRM之间切换。

column1: Produced by Hilltopper Engineering (a spin off of the mercenary command Holt's Hilltoppers) for the Fronc Reaches' Colonial Marshals the TinStar came as a shock both to the Fronc Reaches' neighbors and the local pirate groups when it was introduced in 3086. The initial suit contained a mixture of Clan and Inner Sphere technology that, while being powerful, was regarded as undesirable by the Marshals due to its reliance on outside suppliers. Hilltopper Engineering would accommodate the Marshals request for a more production friendly variant which would lead to the first mass production line outside of vehicles for the Fronc Reaches at the time. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: TinStar由Hilltopper Engineering（佣兵指挥官Holt's Hilltoppers的衍生公司）为Fronc Reaches殖民元帅制造。3086年投入使用时，它让Fronc Reaches的邻邦和当地海盗团伙都大吃一惊。 最初的战斗装甲混合了氏族与内星圈技术，虽然性能强大，却因依赖外部供应商而被元帅们视为不理想。Hilltopper Engineering随后满足元帅们的要求，开发出更适合生产的变体，并由此建立了当时Fronc Reaches除载具之外的首条大规模生产线。 特性：精准 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载任何单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: Drawn on a blank sheet of paper in a museum on Terra, this marvelous craft was inspired by an ancient airplane that followed a curious design ethos. Rather than designing a plane and then mounting weapons, They designed a gun before mounting a plane on it. The same holds true here. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. column2: 这艘奇妙的飞行器是在Terra某座博物馆的一张空白纸上构思出来的，灵感源自一架遵循奇特设计理念的古老飞机。设计者不是先造飞机再装武器，而是先设计一门炮，再把飞机装到炮上。这里也是如此。 生物群系限制：该单位无法部署在月球生物群系。 移动：8/12格 / 240/360米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 160 15 左侧 125 15 右侧 125 15 后方 100 15 总计 525 75 特性：精准武器 - PPC

column1: Developed by The Republic of the Sphere in 3096, this OmniVehicle removes the standard weaponry and replaces the crew compartment with fixed Drone Operating System, Angel ECM Suite, and One-Shot Missiles on all configurations. The top speed and armor protection remain the same as the standard Zephyr. Four tons of pod space available in the turret. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 165 20 Left 120 20 Right 120 20 Rear 95 20 Turret 155 20 Total 655 100 Quirk: Improved Jammer Omni Vehicle
column2: 3096年，The Republic of the Sphere开发了这款全能载具。它移除了标准武器，并在所有配置中以固定式无人机操作系统、天使ECM套件和一次性导弹取代乘员舱。最高速度和装甲防护均与标准Zephyr相同。炮塔可用舱位为4吨。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14格 / 270/420米。 装甲：铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 165 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 95 20 炮塔 155 20 总计 655 100 特性：改良干扰器 全能载具

column1: Developed prior to Gray Monday, the Hel is a Heavy Class OmniMech, which was originally created for the touman of Clan Jade Falcon. Also known as the Hel internally among the Clans, the Loki is an upgraded version of the venerable Hellbringer developed by Clan Hell's Horses in 2926. The new 'Mech differs from its thirtieth century originator by having heavier equipment capacity and improved armor protection but a lower top speed. The 'Mech would become primarily used by Clans Jade Falcon and Hell's Horses in 3145, where the 'Mech would see action during those Clans' invasions of the Inner Sphere powers such as the Republic of the Sphere and Lyran Commonwealth. A noted action that utilized the Loki was during the Jade Falcon's occupation of Sargasso in 3142. The 9th Talon deployed a binary of Lokis to suppress resistance in the city of Salicastrum. The Cluster's Lokis (fitted with B Configurations) used their Long Tom Cannons to blast rebel forces. However, a Nova of Wolf-In-Exiles forces ambushed the binary, and the ensuing battle rendered half the Jade Falcon Lokis destroyed, however the survivors would withdraw temporarily. A Star's worth of survivors from the 9th would return to force a Clan Wolf retreat and prevent the world from falling back into Commonwealth hands. Quirk: Experimental TC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Hel在Gray Monday之前开发，是一台重型全能机甲，最初为Jade Falcon氏族的战斗集群打造。在氏族内部也被称为Hel的Loki，是Hell's Horses氏族于2926年开发的老牌Hellbringer的升级版本。 这台新机甲相比其二十世纪的原型拥有更大的设备容量和更强的装甲防护，但最高速度有所降低。3145年，Jade Falcon氏族和Hell's Horses氏族主要使用这台机甲；在两族入侵内星圈势力（如The Republic of the Sphere和Lyran Commonwealth）期间，Loki参加了战斗。 一次著名的行动发生在3142年Jade Falcon占领Sargasso期间。第9 Talon部署了一个Loki二元组，以镇压Salicastrum城中的抵抗力量。该战斗集群的Loki（采用B配置）使用Long Tom火炮轰击叛军。 然而，一支Wolf-In-Exile部队的Nova伏击了这个二元组，随后的战斗摧毁了一半Jade Falcon的Loki，幸存者只得暂时撤退。第9 Talon的幸存者以一支Star的规模重返战场，迫使Wolf氏族撤退，防止这个世界重新落入联邦手中。 特性：实验型TC 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：全能

column1:
Firmly, you say, "We can help an entire planet suffering from this plague, but we also have to keep this ship flying. We'll split the difference by going through the consortium of drug companies."

As word spreads, your crew takes pride in contributing to the rescue of an entire planet.

The planet's leadership council is also appreciative. While they would have preferred that you'd released the serum to the charity, they're still delighted that any reprieve from the disease is on the horizon.
column2:
你坚定地说：“我们可以帮助整个星球摆脱这场瘟疫，但也必须让这艘船继续飞行。我们会通过药品企业联盟来兼顾两者。”

消息传开后，你的船员们为能参与拯救整个星球而感到自豪。

星球领导委员会也对此表示感谢。虽然他们更希望你把血清捐给慈善机构，但只要疾病有望得到缓解，他们仍然欣喜不已。

column1:
Firmly, you say, "We may be mercenaries, but we can help an entire planet suffering from this plague. We're going to make the most of this opportunity."

As word spreads, your crew is both impressed and proud of contributing to the rescue of an entire planet.

The planet is also materially appreciative. Some gifts are simple cash transfers, and others are more esoteric.

Yang struggles to wear an elaborate headdress, while Darius hefts a bottle of amber liquor appreciatively. "I suppose being the 'good guys' occasionally has its perks."
column2:
你坚定地说：“我们也许是雇佣兵，但可以帮助整个星球摆脱这场瘟疫。我们要充分利用这个机会。”

消息传开后，你的船员们既钦佩又自豪，因为自己参与了拯救整个星球的行动。

这个星球也以实质性的方式表达了谢意。有些礼物是简单的现金转账，另一些则更加别出心裁。

Yang努力戴上一顶华丽的头饰，而Darius则欣然举起一瓶琥珀色烈酒。“我想，偶尔当当‘好人’还是有些好处的。”

column1: The Amazon battle armor was created by the Magistracy of Canopus. Based on the standard Inner Sphere battle armor, the Amazon uses advanced armor to increase protection and provides a jump capability of 90 meters. This allows Amazon-equipped troops to clear obstacles that would stop other battle armor units. The Amazon is used by both the Magistracy and the Capellan Confederation. Amazons deployed by the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces faced Cavalier battle armor and turned in a better performance. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 亚马逊战斗装甲由金星公国设计。它以标准内天体战斗装甲为基础，采用先进装甲来增强防护，并具备90米跳跃能力。这使装备亚马逊战斗装甲的部队能够越过会阻挡其他战斗装甲单位的障碍。亚马逊战斗装甲同时被金星公国和卡佩兰联邦使用。卡佩兰联邦武装部队部署的亚马逊战斗装甲曾与骑士战斗装甲交战，并取得了更好的表现。 特性：标准部件 投放成本倍率：0.888 可搭载Omni单位，可近战，可集群攻击。

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 km/h, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 安祖凭借可靠性深受机甲战士和技师好评；AMSC认为安祖非常适合他们自圣战以来发展出的激进战术。尽管安祖的最大地面速度为64公里/小时，奇尔顿465型跳跃喷口仍可让它跳跃至120米。安祖搭载11吨Starshield A型标准装甲，并内置CASE II，以保护机甲及驾驶员免受弹药爆炸伤害。安祖还采用了与Shadow Hawk相同的生命维持系统；在安祖服役时，这套系统已久经验证。RCA Instatrac Mark X瞄准与跟踪系统则允许安祖同时攻击多个目标，并通过安装的TAG系统为间接火力提供目标指示。 特性：多重追踪 投放成本倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The -8P is based on the experimental -8X. The major differences are the removal of the stealth armor and the head turret. This reduces production cost considerably, but leaves the head-mounted PPC unable to cover the Quickdraw's retreat. The other advanced systems, including the torso cockpit, remain. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: -8P型基于实验型-8X。两者的主要区别是移除了隐形装甲和头部炮塔。这大幅降低了生产成本，但也使安装在头部的PPC无法掩护Quickdraw撤退。包括躯干驾驶舱在内的其他先进系统仍然保留。 特性：超伸展执行器 投放成本倍率：1.08

column1: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The 'Mech is built using a Hermes 380 XL Engine to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 km/h and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 信天翁由自由世界联盟于3053年设计，着眼于应对当时正在推进的氏族可能发动的未来冲突。该机采用Hermes 380 XL引擎，以减轻重量并为武器配置留出最大吨位。信天翁还配备了多种武器，力求在任何距离都能有效作战。该机机动性一般，最高速度为64.8公里/小时，并使用双倍散热器以获得更强的散热能力。 特性：改进型远程瞄准 投放成本倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Bulldog could be called a 'Jack of all trades', featuring a classic layout of one main gun and a few secondary weapons. It is easy to repair and said to be a reliable and cheap asset for any field commander that needs a backbone for his vehicle forces. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 200 30 Left 160 30 Right 160 30 Rear 160 30 Turret 160 30 Total 840 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: 斗牛犬可以称为“万金油”，采用一门主炮加数件副武器的经典布局。它易于维修，被认为是任何需要车辆部队骨干的战地指挥官都能依赖的廉价可靠资产。 生物圈限制：无。 移动力：4/6格 / 120/180米。 装甲：重型铁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 200 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后部 160 30 炮塔 160 30 总计 840 150 特性：主战坦克

column1: The Chameleon was designed to help a new MechWarrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The 'Mech also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces MechWarriors to concentrate on the 'Mech's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when Defiance Industries decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. BattleMechs Incorporated purchased the rights to the design. J.B. BattleMechs also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training 'Mech, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium 'Mech, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 变色龙的设计目的是帮助新晋机甲战士掌握机动和热量管理技巧；它最高速度为97.2公里/小时，跳跃距离达180米。该机几乎完全配备能量武器，但只有10个标准散热器负责冷却。散热器数量不足，迫使机甲战士时刻关注机甲的热量水平。在某些情况下，变色龙也被迫投入战斗，最著名的是龙骑兵内战期间。3052年，蔑视工业决定将生产线转向Nightsky，变色龙的生产曾短暂停止；J.B. BattleMechs公司购得设计权后，生产很快恢复。J.B. BattleMechs还推出了两种适合实战的变色龙改型。变色龙是一种训练机甲，通过搭载种类繁多的武器系统来模拟各种对手。变色龙属于中型机甲，但外观并不总像中型机甲。它可以加装额外装甲板来改变外形，还配备特殊电子设备伪造自身特征；这些能力让它看起来、扫描起来都像其他东西，这正是其名称的由来。 特性：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：1.02

column1: The Atlas 'AS5-HAT'. Pretty typical of pirates to rewire the IFF to be this subtle. It's a pretty standard Atlas chassis, but some genius rewrote the articulation program for the hands to flip the bird when firing. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: Atlas“AS5-HAT”。海盗把敌我识别系统重新接线得如此隐蔽，倒是相当典型。这是一具相当标准的Atlas底盘，但某位天才重写了双手的关节程序，让它在开火时竖起中指。 特性：战斗拳套 投放成本倍率：1.18

column1: The Battle Hawk was originally designed and built at a time when Defiance Industries felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being produced by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that Defiance Industries was still an industry leader in BattleMechs. This came from a 'Mech that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, which puts it on par with 'Mechs fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of armor give it good protection for a light 'Mech. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 战鹰最初设计和建造时，蔑视工业正因自由世界联盟生产并进口的大量装备而感到威胁。它的建造旨在证明蔑视工业仍是机甲行业的领军者。这种机甲虽然以其重量级别而言速度较慢，却是现代战场上不可小觑的力量。战鹰最高速度为86.4公里/小时，足以与比它重15至20吨的机甲并驾齐驱，同时还搭载了与体型相称的强大武器库。它的5.5吨装甲为轻型机甲提供了良好防护。此外，为提高战场机动性，战鹰可以跳跃至150米。 特性：坚固 投放成本倍率：0.99

column1: The Balar was designed by Luthien Armor Works and released alongside the Avatar as a competitor to the Inner Sphere's first OmniMech design. While the Avatar was based upon the clan's Vulture OmniMech, the Balar took cues from the Ebon Jaguar instead. Due to the expense of the 350-rated XL engine, the Balar was overlooked by the DCMS, and went on to be licensed for production by other manufacturers, such as Corean Enterprises, Irian Technologies, and Defiance Industries. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Balar由Luthien装甲工厂设计，与Avatar一同发布，作为内天体首款全能机甲设计的竞争者。Avatar以氏族的Vulture全能机甲为基础，而Balar则借鉴了Ebon Jaguar。由于350额定XL引擎成本高昂，Balar未受到龙蛇联合军事部队青睐，后来获授权由Corean Enterprises、Irian Technologies和蔑视工业等其他制造商生产。 特性：窄型/低轮廓 投放成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：Omni

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones. This specific variant was a prototype non-Omni stolen by Clan Jade Falcon. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 为了延续Mad Cat的传奇，Mk IV采用了其前代巨兽最强大的一些配置，同时整合了更容易寻找和更换的组件。海狐氏族希望该型号能取得与之前型号同样的成功。这个特定改型是由翡翠隼氏族偷走的一具原型非Omni机体。 特性：稳定 投放成本倍率：1.19 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Seems like after they figured how to mass produce their jury rigged junk MML, some Pirates got 'smart' and hotwired some rare streak guidance system into it. It will only fire missiles that will hit, but generates a lot more heat. VOLATILE! Uses Streak LRM/MRM/SRM Ammo. Firing Modes: Streak- LRM, MRM, SRM
column2: 看起来，一些海盗在摸索出大规模生产这种东拼西凑的垃圾MML后，变得“聪明”起来，把罕见的连锁制导系统硬接进了其中。它只会发射能够命中目标的导弹，但会产生更多热量。 易爆！ 使用连锁LRM/MRM/SRM弹药。 射击模式：连锁-LRM、MRM、SRM

column1: RISC Engineers took an interest in the Mercenary-created MML systems and tried to adapt them for a more high tech battlefield. Applying weight saving technologies similar to the LBX autocannons allowed them to increase volley sizes. Uses Clan SRM/LRM Ammo. Left Click on Chance to hit during battle to toggle between LRM or SRM.
column2: RISC工程师对佣兵研发的MML系统产生了兴趣，并试图让其适应技术水平更高的战场。应用类似LBX自动炮的减重技术后，他们得以增大齐射规模。 使用氏族SRM/LRM弹药。 战斗中左键点击命中率，即可在LRM与SRM之间切换。

column1: Rocketstorm Battery Launchers are cheap, unguided, one-shot missile launchers designed to overwhelm by sheer numbers any AMS that can detect them. Counter to many other throw-away systems, Rocketstorm Batteries have two rockets stacked superposed per tube, allowing two full salvos before running empty and becoming dead weight.2 SALVOS! VOLATILE!
column2: 雷暴火箭炮是廉价、无制导、一次性使用的导弹发射器，旨在以纯粹的数量压垮任何能够探测到它们的AMS。与许多其他抛弃式系统不同，雷暴火箭炮的每根发射管内上下叠放两枚火箭，因此在耗尽并变成累赘前可以完成两轮齐射。2轮齐射！ 易爆！

column1: This modified Elemental version was created by Clan Jade Falcon engineers in 3069 and replaces SRM ammunition with Fire-Resistant Armor. It carries a one-shot SRM-2 and a Flamer. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 这个改装的Elemental版本由翡翠隼氏族工程师于3069年制造，用防火装甲取代了SRM弹药。它搭载一具一次性SRM-2和一具火焰喷射器。 特性：标准部件 投放成本倍率：0.93 可搭载Omni单位，可近战，可集群攻击。

column1: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.928 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由拉萨哈格自治领设计，用于支援常规步兵并执行外科式打击。它配备基础隐形装甲，可躲避敌方探测；跳跃喷口则允许其一次跳跃跨越90米。该战斗装甲在对流浪熊战斗装甲进行广泛测试后推出，是那一设计的直接后裔。 特性：设计精良 投放成本倍率：0.928 可搭载Omni单位，可近战，可集群攻击。

column1: The Word of Blake's Bolla Stealth Tank was designed during the early part of the Jihad as part of the Serpentus Series of OmniVehicles. The Bolla's inception was made possible from salvage of Capellan stealth vehicles in 3069 and was first seen in combat in 3072. The tank was designed to support cybernetically enhanced infantry of the Manei Domini and produced by Krupp Armament Works on Terra. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Vehicle Stealth Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 190 30 Left 160 30 Right 160 30 Rear 150 30 Turret 200 30 Total 860 150 Quirk: Off Roader Can Resupply/Repair Omni Vehicle Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.
column2: 布莱克教团的Bolla隐形坦克在圣战初期设计，是Serpentus系列全能战车的一部分。3069年从卡佩兰隐形载具中打捞的部件促成了Bolla的诞生；它于3072年首次出现在战场上。该坦克旨在支援Manei Domini的赛博强化步兵，由Krupp军械厂在地球生产。 生物圈限制：无。 移动力：5/8格 / 150/240米。 装甲：载具隐形装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 190 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后部 150 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 860 150 特性：越野型 可补给/维修 全能战车 可搭载1个战斗装甲小队。

column1: The Zou - or "Elephant" - is one of the third generation of battle armor suits to be designed and fielded by the Draconis Combine. The suit was originally developed to be the successor to the Kanazuchi, an assault suit. It wasn't until the Zou was further developed by being upgraded with command-and-control (C2) capabilities that it came into its own, providing Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery commanders a heavier ground unit when deployed on combined-arms operations, directing troops, calling in long-range fire and artillery. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: Zou——即“大象”——是龙蛇联合设计并列装的第三代战斗装甲之一。这套装甲最初研发是为了取代Kanazuchi突击装甲。直到Zou进一步升级、获得指挥与控制（C2）能力后，它才真正发挥作用：在联合兵种行动中部署时，为龙蛇联合常备军指挥官提供更重型的地面单位，负责指挥部队并召唤远程火力和炮兵支援。 特性：直觉式操控 投放成本倍率：0.892 可搭载Omni单位，可近战，不可集群攻击。

column1: The Wraith battle armor was designed by the Rasalhague Dominion to support conventional infantry as well as perform surgical strikes. It is equipped with Basic Stealth armor to hide it from enemy probes, and its jump jets allow it to cover ninety meters in a single jump. The suit was introduced after extensive testing of the Rogue Bear battle armor, and is a direct descendant of that design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由拉萨哈格自治领设计，用于支援常规步兵并执行外科式打击。它配备基础隐形装甲，可躲避敌方探测；跳跃喷口则允许其一次跳跃跨越90米。该战斗装甲在对流浪熊战斗装甲进行广泛测试后推出，是那一设计的直接后裔。 特性：设计精良 投放成本倍率：0.93 可搭载Omni单位，可近战，可集群攻击。

column1: This variant has had its battlefield endurance and flexibility reduced in favor of maximizing its killing power. It mounts an SRM-5 with only four shots, though that is still more ammunition than most battle armor with missiles carry. A Missile-Capable Modular Weapon Mount can hold a MagShot or a Compact Narc Launcher. Finally, the anti-personnel mount has been replaced with a Firedrake Support Needler Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 这个改型牺牲战场续航和灵活性，以最大化杀伤力。它搭载一具SRM-5，但只有4发弹药；即便如此，仍比大多数携带导弹的战斗装甲拥有更多弹药。导弹适配模块化武器挂点可以容纳MagShot或紧凑型NARC发射器。最后，反人员挂点被Firedrake支援针刺枪取代。 特性：伏击者 投放成本倍率：0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，不可集群攻击。

column1: We here at Quicsell know that weight and heat are both paramount when it comes to weapon design, so we managed to trim our LRM launchers down from what our most common competitors use by cutting out some of the unnessesary complexity in their launchers. Who really needs that much guidance hardware anyway? Not you, that's who! Remember to pick up a pack of our LRM ammo while you shop!
column2: Quicsell公司深知，在武器设计中重量和热量至关重要，因此我们削减了发射器中那些不必要的复杂结构，让LRM发射器比最常见的竞争产品更加轻巧。毕竟，谁真的需要那么多制导硬件呢？你不需要，就是这样！购物时别忘了顺手买一包我们的LRM弹药！

column1: Wanting to improve on the Raven but finding themselves constrained by the core equipment loadout, House Liao engineers looked at radical changes. Most promising of these attempts was the Gui Guisui, so named because it "flew in like a stealthed spirit". Being a 25t LAM version of the Raven, the Gui Guisui carries a similar EWAR loadout including stealth armor, as well as a pair of built in Medium lasers and a wing-mounted pulse laser, as well as a weapon bay of Chaff. The versatility of the wing mount and bay have allowed alternative loadouts to be utilized; several operations consisting of Gui Guisui stealthily dropping support equipment to resistance fighters have been reported. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 为改进乌鸦级，却受核心装备配置所限，辽家工程师转而寻求激进的改造方案。其中最有希望的尝试便是鬼鬼隋，因其“如隐形幽灵般飞入”而得名。作为一款25吨级的乌鸦级陆空机甲，鬼鬼隋搭载了相近的电子战配置，包括隐形装甲、一对内置中型激光以及一门翼载脉冲激光，并配有一组箔条发射器。机翼挂架和武器舱的灵活性使其能够采用不同的配置；据报，鬼鬼隋曾多次隐秘空降支援装备，交付给抵抗战士。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: When the Argo arrives at the source of the distress beacon, a bleak scene greets you. The transport drifts aimlessly, no longer even venting oxygen from a gaping hole in its hull.\n\nWhile you're too late to help, your tech staff does manage to salvage some scrap for the Mech Bay from the floating tomb. Darius, watching with you, says, "Grim work, but necessary for survival in the Periphery."
column2: 当阿戈号抵达求救信标源头时，映入你眼帘的是一片凄凉景象。运输船漫无目的地漂浮着，船体上那个巨大的破洞甚至已不再泄漏氧气。\n\n虽然你们来得太迟，没能提供援助，但技术人员还是从这座漂浮的墓穴中打捞出一些废料，供机甲维修舱使用。达瑞斯与你一同注视着这一切，说道：“活儿干得真够惨，但想在边境活下去，就得如此。”

column1: This was an Advanced Tactical Missile system, before someone turned it into this wreckage. This is the famous case of getting a weapon into some nutcase's hand but no ammo for it. The whole system has been turned upside down, the Artemis got completely yanked out and they put a jury rigged RAC-feeder in its place, allowing to fire all common Inner Sphere Munitions. VOLATILE! Uses LRM/MRM/SRM Ammo. Firing Modes: LRM, MRM, SRM
column2: 这原本是一套先进战术导弹系统，后来不知被谁改成了这副废铜烂铁的模样。这正是把武器交到某个疯子手里，却没给他配弹药的典型案例。整套系统被彻底改得面目全非：阿尔忒弥斯系统被整个拆掉，换上了临时拼凑的RAC供弹器，因此可以发射所有常见的内星域弹药。 易爆！ 使用LRM/MRM/SRM弹药。 射击模式：LRM、MRM、SRM

column1: This variant trades the Beagle probe for a Guardian ECM suite, allowing Coalition forces to disrupt Word of Blake communication networks and targeting systems. The Sprint scout helicopter is a nimble fast scout platform popular within the Inner Sphere. It was first released in 3052 with much success to the beleaguered units along the Clan invasion corridor, where it was able to keep tabs on the swift deployments of the Clans and call in artillery from afar. Such was its success that it quickly became a favored unit within scout and recon detachments throughout the Inner Sphere where it continues to see widespread use. However the nature of battlefields within the Inner Sphere often highlight the one flaw of the design, its mediocre armor. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 40 5 Left 20 5 Right 20 5 Rear 20 5 Total 110 25 Quirk: Improved Communications
column2: 该型号以守护者ECM套件取代了比格尔探测器，使联盟军能够干扰布莱克之语的通信网络与瞄准系统。斯普林特侦察直升机机动灵活、速度快，在内星域广受欢迎。它于3052年首次推出，并在氏族入侵走廊沿线的苦战部队中大获成功；凭借它，部队得以追踪氏族的快速部署，并从远处呼叫炮火支援。凭借如此出色的表现，它很快成为内星域侦察分队的常用装备，至今仍被广泛使用。然而，内星域战场的环境往往会暴露该设计唯一的缺陷：装甲平庸。 生物群系限制：无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：13/20格 / 390/600米。 装甲：铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 40 5 左侧 20 5 右侧 20 5 后方 20 5 总计 110 25 特性：改良通信

column1: Two Firebees leftover from the Age of War were upgraded in 3071 when Sun-Tzu Liao revealed that he had survived the WarShip bombardment of Sian. They are protected by Stealth Armor and the requisite Guardian ECM Suite. Trading on the 'Mech's name, the Large Laser is replaced with a Plasma Rifle and the SRMs gave way to a multi-missile launcher. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 3071年，孙祖·辽现身，透露自己在新安号战舰轰炸中幸存下来；两台战争年代遗留下来的萤火虫级也因此得到升级。它们由隐形装甲和配套的守护者ECM套件提供保护。为了呼应机甲的名字，原有的大型激光被等离子步枪取代，SRM则换成了多用途导弹发射器。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The primary configuration uses a Heavy PPC for the main firepower, while two Medium Re-Engineered Lasers are supplemented by a pair of MML-5s. Two tons of MML ammunition are located in a CASE II protected bay, and three additional double heat sinks bring the total to fifteen. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该机的主要配置以重型PPC作为核心火力，两门中型重构激光辅以一对MML-5。两吨MML弹药存放在由CASE II保护的舱室中，另外三具双重散热器将总数提升至十五具。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂作动器限制：全能

column1: The Ogre heavy battle armor has a physically intimidating appearance, largely due to the twin Heavy Battle Claws used as weapons and Tvastar's choice to use an unusually wide frame for the suit. Despite that appearance, the Ogre isn't well-suited to fighting conventional infantry, but the heavy armor and weapons mounted on the Ogre allows it to attack enemy armor, and actions in certain early battles saw the Ogre gain a reputation for tearing tanks in half - a reputation that was rather fanciful, but did serve to enhance the Ogre's reputation. The Ogre has since been exported outside the Regulan Fiefs by Tvastar, with the Duchy of Andurien and the Lyran Commonwealth both ordering large production runs. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 食人魔重型战斗装甲外形极具压迫感，主要归功于用作武器的一对重型战斗爪，以及特瓦斯塔为装甲服选用的异常宽大框架。尽管外表威猛，食人魔并不擅长对付普通步兵；不过，其厚重装甲与所搭载的武器足以攻击敌方装甲单位。在早期几场战斗中，食人魔曾因把坦克撕成两半而声名大噪——这种说法颇为夸张，却确实进一步提升了它的名声。此后，特瓦斯塔将食人魔出口到雷古兰封地以外，安杜里恩公国和莱拉联邦都订购了大批产品。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：0.892 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可被攀附。

column1: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of `Common Sense Rules` for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 线卫级是克雷斯利军工厂推出的第一款战斗机甲。它的设计遵循一套“常识准则”。这种思路造就了一台地面速度良好、装甲与火力都相当可靠的机甲。线卫级的最高速度为86.4千米/小时，除了最快的轻型和中型机甲外，它都能跟上。它还配备了十吨装甲和十四具散热器。采用现成武器与装备的组合，使线卫级可靠、易于维修，在战场上也值得信赖。然而，对小型部队和小贵族等目标客户而言，线卫级最具吸引力之处终究是物美价廉。上市第一年，它在历史上同其他55吨级战斗机甲相比取得了非凡的成功。对于买得起全新战斗机甲的小型派系来说，线卫级已成为首选驻防机甲。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂作动器限制：左下、右下

column1: The Kamakiri mounts three weapon systems mounted in the front of the VTOL - a single Tiegart Particle Projection Cannon and a pair of Telos ThunderShot Thunderbolt 10 Missile Launchers. The Kamakiri Attack VTOL was developed at the end of the thirty-first century by Yan Manufacturing of New Samarkand as a result of their growing success in the military aerospace market. Dubbed as resembling a praying mantis, the Kamakiri was an immediate success; the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery personnel responsible for supervising the first vehicle trial watched for just two minutes before approving the Kamakiri for purchase. Moving as fast as many reconnaissance and strike platforms in service with the DCMS already thanks to the DAV 155 XL extra light engine, the original specification armor installed by Yan was replaced with seven tons of StarGuard Aurora Reflective at the request of the DCMS, who wanted to improve the Kamakari's protection against energy weapons, although the nature of the Reflective Armor didn't offer any additional protection against the flak commonly directed at VTOLs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Reflective Coating Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 30 Left 140 30 Right 140 30 Rear 100 30 Total 580 150 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Wingmounted
column2: 螳螂直升机的前部装有三套武器系统：一门泰加特粒子投射炮，以及一对泰洛斯雷霆射手雷霆之击10型导弹发射器。螳螂攻击型垂直起降飞行器由新撒马尔坎的燕氏制造公司在三十一世纪末研发，当时该公司在军用航空市场上日渐成功。这款飞行器因外形酷似螳螂而得名，一经推出便大获成功；负责监督首次车辆试验的龙蛇联合军士兵只观察了两分钟，就批准采购。得益于DAV 155 XL超轻引擎，它的速度已可媲美DCMS现役的许多侦察与突击平台。应DCMS要求，燕氏最初配备的装甲被七吨星卫极光反射装甲取代，以增强其抵御能量武器的能力；不过，反射装甲无法额外防护常用于攻击垂直起降飞行器的高爆破片。 生物群系限制：无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：7/11格 / 210/330米。 装甲：反射涂层 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 175 30 左侧 140 30 右侧 140 30 后方 100 30 总计 580 150 特性：精准武器 - 翼载

column1: The Moltke Main Battle Tank was created for the Duchy of Andurien. The Duchy commissioned Brooks Inc. to create the tank to enable the Duchy's military to fill its military gaps, without relying on outside sources for equipment and parts. The tank is based on the Age of War Augustus A-3 Tank. The tank began production in 3076, and has since been dispersed among the League forces on station in the Duchy. Outside parties have inquired to Brooks for purchasing the tank for their forces. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 350 40 Left 245 40 Right 245 40 Rear 160 40 Turret 260 40 Total 1260 200 Quirk: Variable Range Targeting
column2: 莫尔特克主战坦克是为安杜里恩公国打造的。公国委托布鲁克斯公司研发该坦克，以弥补本国军队的装备缺口，避免依赖外部来源获取装备和零部件。该坦克以战争年代的奥古斯都A-3型坦克为基础，于3076年开始投产，此后陆续配发给驻扎在公国的联盟军部队。外部势力也曾向布鲁克斯公司询价，希望为自己的部队采购该坦克。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6格 / 120/180米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 350 40 左侧 245 40 右侧 245 40 后方 160 40 炮塔 260 40 总计 1260 200 特性：可变距离瞄准

column1: The Maxim Mark II transport is produced by Cyclops Inc. of Skye and Scarborough Manufacturers. The vehicle was intended as an upgrade from the original Maxim hover transport. Though Cyclops wanted to build on the long history of the original Maxim and continue to use heavy weapons, Scarborough’s engineers pointed out that by carrying fewer weapons the crew would naturally withdraw from the battlefield before getting into overly dangerous situations. This would keep the Maxim Mk. II in service for a longer time, allowing the Republic Armed Forces to spend more money on battle armor and other equipment. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 170 25 Left 100 25 Right 100 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 100 25 Total 570 125 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Can carry 4 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: 马克西姆II型运输车由斯凯的独眼巨人公司与斯卡伯勒制造公司联合生产。该车原本是对初代马克西姆悬浮运输车的升级。独眼巨人公司希望延续初代马克西姆的悠久传统，继续搭载重型武器；但斯卡伯勒的工程师指出，少装一些武器能让乘员在局势过于危险前主动撤出战场。这样一来，马克西姆II型便能服役更久，共和国武装部队也能把更多经费用于战斗装甲和其他装备。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12格 / 240/360米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 170 25 左侧 100 25 右侧 100 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 570 125 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 可搭载4个战斗装甲小队。配有射击孔。

column1: The Saladin Mk II HCV is a redesigned version of the original Third Succession War-era Saladin combat vehicle prized for its hitting power and speed. This new version of the Scarborough Manufacturers' famous line of hovercrafts would be first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. While retaining the speed of the original model, the Saladin MK II is considerably better protected by Scarborough engineers using 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The tank's primary weapon is its front-mounted Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. While this has less punch than the original's heavy Autocannon, the PPC has no ammunition needs, allowing it to keep fighting longer and at greater ranges. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 245 20 Left 120 20 Right 120 20 Rear 90 20 Total 575 80 Quirk: Nimble
column2: 萨拉丁II型高速战斗悬浮车是对第三次继承战争时期初代萨拉丁战车的重新设计；初代以强劲火力和高速著称。这个斯卡伯勒制造公司悬浮车系列的新型号预计将在三十二世纪中叶投产。斯卡伯勒的工程师在保留初代速度的同时，使用5.5吨重型铁磁纤维装甲大幅提升了防护能力。坦克的主武器是前置的玛格纳耀斑星短管粒子投射炮。它的威力不及初代的重型自动炮，但PPC无需弹药，因此能够持续作战，并在更远距离交火。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：10/15格 / 300/450米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 245 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 90 20 总计 575 80 特性：灵巧

column1: The two massive railguns defines the Arachnid's primary configuration, both in appearance and in design. Even with the railguns taking up almost two thirds of the available internal space and weight capacity in the giant QuadMech, two ER PPC and an ER Large laser are mounted in the center torso to provide even more firepower. Using 33.5 tons of the latest Titano-Carbide Lamellor armor still allows more than enough armor to survive even the strongest attacks with just minor damages. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45
column2: 两门巨型轨道炮定义了蛛形机甲的主要配置，无论外观还是设计皆是如此。即便轨道炮占去了这台巨型四足机甲近三分之二的内部空间与载重，中央躯干仍装有两门ER PPC和一门ER大型激光，进一步增强火力。使用33.5吨最新型钛碳化物层压装甲后，它依然拥有充足防护，足以承受最猛烈的攻击而只受轻微损伤。 特性：威慑 部署费用倍率：1.45

column1: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. Although he was victorious against a Thor, it was noted that the Tomahawk still suffered from numerous system errors and gremlins and was not yet ready for mass production. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 战斧级是狼氏族于3065年设计的突击级全能机甲。同年9月前，少数原型机已经制造完成，并开始进行试运行。其中一台原型机由内森·沃尔夫驾驶，在塔玛尔的一场平等决斗中获胜，由此晋升为星队上校。尽管他击败了雷神级，但战斧级仍存在大量系统故障和隐患，尚未达到量产标准。内森仍将这台机甲留作后来调任欧米茄星团时的座驾，并于3064年4月11日在星之尽头星系的新克雷西达斯成功驾驶它投入战斗。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.19 手臂作动器限制：全能

column1: The Void is a battle armor design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth armor and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle armor. Many Nova Cats found the original PPC too bulky, so they swapped it out with their version of the Magshot Gauss Rifle. Quirk: Void Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 虚空是一款由龙蛇联合研发生产的战斗装甲。它配备隐形装甲，机动性颇佳，还能进行跳跃。许多新星猫战士觉得初始配置的PPC过于笨重，于是换成了他们版本的磁射高斯步枪。 特性：虚空 部署费用倍率：0.89 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可被攀附。

column1: The UrbanLord appears to be a very heavy counterpart to the much older UrbanMech, weighing in at 70 metric tons, making it two entire weightclasses heavier than the UM-R60 UrbanMech. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 都市领主看起来像是年代久远的都市机甲的重型对应型号，重量达到70吨，比UM-R60都市机甲足足高出两个重量级。 特性：360°躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂作动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The Sortek Assault Hover Craft is a thirty-second century combat hovercraft, originally produced by Corean Enterprises for the armed forces of the Federated Suns. Built on New Avalon, Corean Enterprises constructed the craft as a means to repeat its success with its last successful hovercraft, the Musketeer. The Sortek was used by many Armed Forces of the Federated Suns combat units by the 3140s to rebuild their devastated forces. Many AFFS commanders would mistakenly use the Sortek as a main combatant, which would cause heavy casualties due to the Sortek's lack of being able to deliver a killing blow to a heavier opponent. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 25 Left 120 25 Right 120 25 Rear 110 25 Total 525 100 Quirk: Improved Sensors
column2: 索泰克突击悬浮艇是三十二世纪的战斗悬浮艇，最初由科里安企业为联邦太阳军队生产。科里安企业在新亚瓦隆建造该艇，希望借此复制其上一款成功悬浮艇“火枪手”的成绩。到了3140年代，许多联邦太阳军队战斗部队使用索泰克来重建遭受重创的兵力。许多联邦太阳军指挥官误将索泰克当作主力战斗单位，结果伤亡惨重，因为它缺乏击杀更强对手的能力。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12格 / 240/360米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 175 25 左侧 120 25 右侧 120 25 后方 110 25 总计 525 100 特性：改良传感器

column1: The Solitaire is a fast, heavily armored light BattleMech. The twenty five-ton design is one of the fastest in existence, allowing it to pick off enemy units that stray too far from support like a lioness hunting a pack of wildebeest. The Solitaire is capable of operating far from supply lines, as it carries an all-energy weapon complement and four and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 独行者是一款速度极快、装甲厚重的轻型战斗机甲。这款25吨级设计是现存速度最快的机甲之一，能够像母狮捕猎角马群一样，迅速猎杀脱离支援范围的敌方单位。独行者全副武器均为能量武器，配有4.5吨铁磁纤维装甲，因此能够在远离补给线的区域持续作战。 特性：改良冷却套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Titan II is a BattleMech produced by Kressly WarWorks on Epsilon Eridani for the Word of Blake's Protectorate Militia. First identified by the Successor States in 3071, the Titan II owes its existence to the Titan, a prototype that dates to 2765. Like the original, the Titan II has a top speed of 54 km/h and nineteen tons of standard armor. Since the 'Mech is produced for the Blakists' garrison forces, it makes no use of expensive, weight-saving technologies. It also lacks the advanced electronics that have become the hallmark of Word military forces. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 泰坦II型是克雷斯利军工厂在厄普西隆·厄里达尼星为布莱克之语保护国民兵生产的战斗机甲。继承国于3071年首次发现该机型。泰坦II型源自泰坦原型机，后者可追溯至2765年。与初代相同，泰坦II型最高速度为54千米/小时，并配有十九吨标准装甲。由于它是为布莱克派的驻防部队生产的，因此没有采用昂贵的减重技术，也缺少布莱克之语军队的标志性先进电子设备。 特性：受保护的作动器 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: With its focus on defense, the 'Mech is armed with very few weapons for an Assault. The GTR-1's main armament is its Large X-Pulse Laser, which is backed up by three Medium X-Pulse Lasers, all of which are linked to a Targeting Computer. To provide additional mobility, the Great Turtle is equipped with three torso-mounted Jump Jets. These allow the Great Turtle to get out of sticky situations relatively quickly. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这台机甲专注防御，却只配备了极少的强袭级武器。GTR-1 的主武器是大型 X 脉冲激光，另有三门中型 X 脉冲激光支援，全部接入瞄准计算机。为了提高机动性，Great Turtle 在躯干安装了三具跳跃喷口，让它能较快摆脱危险局面。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: You look Front Man directly in the face, "How much?" Front Man looks intrigued, "How much for what, my dear Commander?" "How much to buy [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s marker? No strings, no further obligations," you state succinctly. Front Man steeples his fingers, "You would be willing to bail [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] out of the hole they dug themselves into? Interesting... very well, if you wish to end this here an now it will cost you ¢1,161,380. My assistant has just sent you the account details." You turn to Darius, "Make the transfer." Darius types in some information into the console, then nods, "Transfer complete Commander." Front Man looks away for a minute before turning back to you, "The deal is done, Commander. You are an interesting one, I do so hope we meet again!" As you kill the connection, you state, "The feeling is NOT mutual." The holocom connection closes. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes over and grabs your hand, "Thank you! I... I do not know what to say!" You smile at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Just do your job and be the best MechWarrior you can. Oh, and no more gambling!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] cannot keep the smile of {SCN_MW.OBJ} face, "Absolutely Commander!"
column2: 你直视中间人的脸：“多少钱？” 中间人饶有兴致地问：“亲爱的指挥官，什么多少钱？” “买下 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的债务标记要多少钱？没有附加条件，也没有后续义务。”你简洁地说道。 中间人十指交叉：“你愿意把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 从自己挖的坑里捞出来？有意思……很好，如果你想就此了结，现在要花费 ¢1,161,380。我的助手刚刚把账户详情发给你。” 你转向达利乌斯：“进行转账。” 达利乌斯在控制台输入信息，然后点头道：“转账完成，指挥官。” 中间人移开视线片刻，随后转身对你说道：“交易完成了，指挥官。你真是个有趣的人，希望我们还能再见！” 你切断连接时说道：“这种感觉可不是相互的。”全息通讯连接关闭。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 冲过来抓住你的手：“谢谢你！我……我都不知道该说什么了！” 你对 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 微笑：“做好自己的工作，成为最优秀的机甲战士。还有，不许再赌博了！” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 无法掩饰 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 脸上的笑容：“遵命，指挥官！”

Interesting... very well, if you wish to end this here an now it will cost you ¢1,102,563. My assistant has just sent you the account details." You turn to Darius, "Make the transfer." Darius types in some information into the console, then nods, "Transfer complete Commander." Front Man looks away for a minute before turning back to you, "The deal is done, Commander. You are an interesting one, I do so hope we meet again!" As you kill the connection, you state, "The feeling is NOT mutual." The holocom connection closes. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes over and grabs your hand, "Thank you! I... I do not know what to say!" You smile at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Just do your job and be the best MechWarrior you can. Oh, and no more gambling!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] cannot keep the smile of {SCN_MW.OBJ} face, "Absolutely Commander!"
column2: 你直视中间人的脸：“多少钱？” 中间人饶有兴致地问：“亲爱的指挥官，什么多少钱？” “买下 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的债务标记要多少钱？没有附加条件，也没有后续义务。”你简洁地说道。 中间人十指交叉：“你愿意把 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 从自己挖的坑里捞出来？有意思……很好，如果你想就此了结，现在要花费 ¢1,102,563。我的助手刚刚把账户详情发给你。” 你转向达利乌斯：“进行转账。” 达利乌斯在控制台输入信息，然后点头道：“转账完成，指挥官。” 中间人移开视线片刻，随后转身对你说道：“交易完成了，指挥官。你真是个有趣的人，希望我们还能再见！” 你切断连接时说道：“这种感觉可不是相互的。”全息通讯连接关闭。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 冲过来抓住你的手：“谢谢你！我……我都不知道该说什么了！” 你对 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 微笑：“做好自己的工作，成为最优秀的机甲战士。还有，不许再赌博了！” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 无法掩饰 {SCN_MW.OBJ} 脸上的笑容：“遵命，指挥官！”

column1: You frown, "So get the parts from storage and replace them." Farah grabs her noteputer and scans the inventory. A few moments later, she turns to you shaking her head, "Commander, it appears we do not have enough of the needed parts, a set of [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_KerbyInjectors],Kerby Injectors]], a [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_FuCapacitor],Fu Capacitor]] and a functional [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_CheatahNavComputer],Cheatah Nav Computer]], in storage to repair the Console." You look over at the other bridge crew, "Well, anyone got any ideas where we can get more of these parts?" Darius chimes in, "We obtained the original parts from some key contracts for some of the various pirates out in the abandoned systems. We could head out there and see if any of their command is feeling generous." Yang clears his throat, "We maybe don't need to go all guns blazing and what not. I've found that certain planets, namely those that have a shadier mercantile presence, will almost always have what you need, for a price in C-Bills." You sit back in your command chair, "So now we are on a bloody treasure hunt..." The KF Console is still non-functionalSTATUS: OFFLINE.
column2: 你皱眉道：“那就从仓库取出零件换上。” Farah 抓起数据板查看库存。片刻后，她摇头说道：“指挥官，仓库里似乎没有足够的零件。要修复控制台，我们还缺一套 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_KerbyInjectors],Kerby 注射器]]、一个 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_FuCapacitor],Fu 电容器]]，以及一个可用的 [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_CheatahNavComputer],Cheatah 导航计算机]]。” 你看向其他舰桥船员：“好吧，有人知道还能从哪里找到这些零件吗？” 达利乌斯插话：“最初的零件来自废弃星系里几个海盗的关键合同。我们可以去那里看看他们的头目是否愿意慷慨一把。” Yang 清了清嗓子：“不必一上来就火力全开。我发现某些星球，尤其是商贸关系比较灰色的地方，几乎总能找到你需要的东西——当然得用 C-Bills 购买。” 你靠回指挥椅：“所以现在变成了一场该死的寻宝游戏……” KF 控制台仍无法运行状态：离线。

column1: You are on the bridge when Sumire calls out, "Commander, we have an incoming holovid transmission." You motion to Sumire to accept the transmission, "Greetings, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Nice to see you again, I trust things have been well?" You look at Front Man, "Seriously? I lost a damned good pilot to your Game last time! I know why you are contacting me, so get to the point. Which of my crew owes you money this time?" Front Man smiles, "Ah, direct and to the point, I knew there was a reason I liked you {COMMANDER.LastName}. Very well then. You currently employ [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and yes, they owe us more than ¢1,000,000, which is now overdue. We must insist that debt is paid in full. Allow [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] to participate in the Game and we can put this matter behind us all." [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] turns to you, "Commander, if they are still willing to wipe my debt AND reward us at the same time, I am all in!" You turn to [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "You can DIE, man!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] stands up straight, "I am tired of hiding Commander." You sigh, and turn to address Front Man, "Your proposal the same as last time we spoke?" Front Man steeples his fingers in front of him, "Absolutely. I will restate it now to avoid any confusion. My employer asks that [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] plays in a game. Winning the game will result in {SCN_MW.DET} debt being wiped and your company will receive a crate of 'goodies'. Should [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] fail in achieving victory, their debt will be paid in a more permanent manner." "What is your decision, Commander?" says Front Man.
column2: 你在舰桥上，Sumire 喊道：“指挥官，我们收到一段全息影像通讯。” 你示意 Sumire 接通：“你好，指挥官 {COMMANDER.LastName}。很高兴再次见到你，希望一切顺利？” 你看向中间人：“认真的吗？上次你的游戏害我失去了一名优秀驾驶员！我知道你为什么联系我，直说吧。这次又是我的哪名船员欠你钱？” 中间人笑道：“直截了当，我就知道自己喜欢你是有原因的，{COMMANDER.LastName}。很好，你现在雇用了 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]，而且他们欠我们的钱超过 ¢1,000,000，如今已经逾期。我们坚持要求全额偿还。让 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 参加游戏，我们就能把这件事一笔勾销。” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 转向你：“指挥官，如果他们愿意抹掉我的债务，还能让我们同时获利，那我参加！” 你转向 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]：“你会死的，混蛋！” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 挺直身体：“我受够了躲躲藏藏，指挥官。” 你叹了口气，转向中间人：“你的提议和上次一样？” 中间人十指交叉：“当然。为免混淆，我现在重述一遍。我的雇主要求 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 参加一场游戏。赢下游戏后，{SCN_MW.DET} 的债务会被抹掉，而你的公司还会收到一箱‘好东西’。如果 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 没能获胜，他们的债务就会以更永久的方式结清。” 中间人问道：“指挥官，你的决定是什么？”

column1: Won in combat on Arc-Royal after the Wolf's Dragoons arrival, the reborn Black Widow Company's XO Jacob Kincaid set about upgrading his new 'Mech significantly. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 黑寡妇连队重组后，狼龙佣兵团抵达皇家狼星，副指挥官雅各布·金凯德在战斗中赢得了这台新机甲，随后便着手对其进行大幅升级。 特性：兜帽 部署费用倍率：1.06 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: With the success of the Mad Cat Mk II design Clan Diamond Shark developed the Mad Cat III as a medium 'Mech to accompany the heavy Mad Cat and assault Mad Cat II. Intended for sale to both Inner Sphere and Clan customers, it has been shunned by the Clans save for the Nova Cats and Exiled Wolves as '...an outrage against everything Nicholas Kerensky stood for and taught us.' However, it has proven popular with the Successor States. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 随着 Mad Cat Mk II 设计大获成功，钻石鲨氏族开发了中型机甲 Mad Cat III，以搭配重型 Mad Cat 和突击型 Mad Cat II。它原本计划同时面向内星和氏族客户销售，却遭到氏族普遍冷落，只有新星猫和流亡之狼例外；氏族称其“……违背了尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所坚持并教导的一切”。不过，它在继承者诸国中颇受欢迎。 特性：通讯强化 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

No strings, no further obligations," you state succinctly. Front Man steeples his fingers, "You would be willing to bail [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] out of the hole they dug themselves into? Interesting... very well, if you wish to end this here an now it will cost you ¢1,067,344. My assistant has just sent you the account details." You turn to Darius, "Make the transfer." Darius types in some information into the console, then nods, "Transfer complete Commander." Front Man looks away for a minute before turning back to you, "The deal is done, Commander. You are an interesting one, I do so hope we meet again!" As you kill the connection, you state, "The feeling is NOT mutual." The holocom connection closes. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] rushes over and grabs your hand, "Thank you! I... I do not know what to say!" You smile at [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], "Just do your job and be the best MechWarrior you can. Oh, and no more gambling!" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] cannot keep the smile of {SCN_MW.OBJ} face, "Absolutely Commander!"

column1:
Born on Royal Foxx to an influential Canopian family, DeVega grew up in a privileged environment and luxury of extremes for the Periphery nation. Unfortunately, like most of his peers, DeVega let this fortune go to his head and fill him with privileged ideas and plans, none of which would come to pass.

Enrolling in the best academies that money and prestige could buy didn't matter. The Star League fell, and the wars that occurred leading to that claimed his family before seeing him join the SLDF for vengeance upon Amaris for what his schemes caused.

What was surprising was DeVega's ability in point-blank 'Mech brawling. Quickly rising to command a company, the numerous city fights saw him taking his signature Black Knight into brutal close-range combat.

When the war ended and the SLDF left, DeVega went with them. With no home to return to, he joined the Exodus and left the Inner Sphere behind for what he assumed would be a new life. But even in Exile, the SLDF faced war, so once more, he left a home behind.

The Clans were where he finally settled. Joining Clan Wolf, he earned the position of Star Colonel during the initial Trials, and after the Founder disappeared he was chosen to be Khan. Viewing people as one of their most valuable resources, it was not long before he came into conflict with other Clans, resulting first in a victorious absorption of Smoke Jaguar, then yet another Exodus - this time back to the Inner Sphere.

With several colonial territories established, Clan Wolf fought in war after war, and numerous Trials. Making allies and enemies alike, Clan Wolf under his leadership flourished, culminating in a climactic Trial of Possession for Terra itself. A Trial that saw the Wolf once again the victors, and his taking the title of ilKhan.
column2:
德维加出生于皇家福克斯星一个颇有影响力的坎诺普斯家族，在这个边疆国度里，他从小便生活在优渥乃至奢华的环境中。可惜，他和大多数同辈一样，被这份财富冲昏了头脑，满脑子都是特权阶层的想法与计划，而那些计划一个也没能实现。

再好的学院，只要有钱有地位就能进去，也没能改变什么。星盟覆灭了，随之而来的战争夺走了他的家人；为了向阿玛瑞斯复仇，也为了清算那场阴谋带来的后果，他加入了星盟国防军。

真正令人意外的是，德维加极擅长近距离机甲格斗。他很快升任连队指挥官，在一场又一场城市巷战中，驾驶着自己的招牌机甲“黑骑士”投入残酷的近身战。

战争结束、星盟国防军撤离时，德维加随军离开。无家可归的他加入了大撤离，把内层星域抛在身后，以为那里会有一段新人生。然而即使在流亡途中，星盟国防军仍旧战火不断，他又一次背井离乡。

最终，他在氏族中安顿下来。加入狼之氏族后，他在最初的试炼中赢得了“星上校”的职位；始祖消失后，他又被选为可汗。他把人视为最宝贵的资源，很快便与其他氏族发生冲突：先是获胜并吞并烟雾美洲虎氏族，随后又经历了一次大撤离——这回，目的地是内层星域。

建立起数个殖民领地后，狼之氏族在一场又一场战争和无数次试炼中壮大。德维加治下的狼之氏族既结交盟友，也树立敌人，最终迎来争夺泰拉本身的决定性占有试炼。狼之氏族再次取胜，而他也由此获得了“伊尔可汗”的头衔。
